title: TOLUWANISINGS : LESSONS YOU AND I MUST LEARN ABOUT HIM.
text:
TOLUWANISINGS : LESSONS YOU AND I MUST LEARN ABOUT HIM.
By Latunde Akin 
I can't believe there are many Christian believers that still doesn't believe life is a battlefield and that after experiencing salvation in Christ,you still have a lot of battle to fight against your former foundation from your bloodline. Every believer should know they have work to do.
I heard TOLUWANISINGS on interview with a nollywood actress stating categorically that he doesn't believe in fighting battles or singing about battle against evil than only to worship God.
I actually understand him so well and I agreed with him about being focused of worshiping and singing about the finished work of Christ. 
What I personally discovered in the interview was just that he seemed to neglect the need to fight battles. Leaving battles aside for God to fight is good but we are the one God will still use to do it. God expected us to fight it squarely so he can help us with His power.
Secondly a lot believed he was 41 years old,later to discover he was 34 year. I don't personally know how such wrong narrative emerged into the public but this is what I think happened. He probably lived mature than his age and people around him thought there are things he had known. Else they would have taught him how to handle things better. 
His mother demised when he was six month. He lived and was catered for by his mother's sibling. He never enjoyed parental upbringing. So there wasn't so much connection between him and his biological father. 
Much more his father is still a Muslim,likewise his direct family from his father's house. He built the first house,second house and God lifted him into limelight. Definitely and certainly,those unbelieving people from his house will want to start a spiritual battle against him. Apart from the one he will face for the fame or from outside. 
"Bi ogun ile koba jani,tode ko le pani". If battle from inside isn't fighting you,battle from outside can't succeed "
For every believer,I always advise that we must always be battle ready. We must understand that success doesn't mean battle is over. Salvation in Christ doesn't mean battle is over. The finished work of Jesus doesn't mean we must be ignorant of the devices of the devil. 
Toluwanisings didn't die at a ripe age we all expect and this brings about many concerns to a lot of people. We may say God knows the best but we still know it's not normal. 
Health wise every person must always be sensitive to what their health is saying. Do get checked up often and monitor your blood pressure always.  We shouldn't totally spiritualise matters when it's purely medical ignorance because of work work and work. 
I can still tell you your need and assignment as a believer is to first face and fight the battery from your father's house on your knees every night before or after any success in your life. If you don't,they may come back to hunt at a time you least expected.  And they do this in collaboration with the public or people from the outside. So you won't suspect where is the source of the trouble is coming from. You will be pointing hand towards people you met at work,church,neighbours outside ,when the real source is from your ignored background or foundation. They only collaborated. 
In a bit to help a lot of people maintain consistent prayer life. We have set up a 1 hour prayer time on telegram group (not intercessory group). Where we all pray together every night and fight our battles together. The time is 11pm to 12am every day. 
AND WE HAVE STARTED THIS SINCE 767 days ago. Which means we are 767 days into it already. We chose 11pm to 12am because there is power in night prayers. Any decisions any evil personalities are making against anyone,it's that time we dismantle them everyday. And as we break into 12 am which is when everyday begins,we began prophesying over the day. 
There is power in consistency. You don't have to spend long hours praying. 1 hour every night is power. We pray on just one prayer theme for a week. Your battles can't survive it. Join us through the channel in pinned in the comment section.
May the Lord sustain Toluwanisings wife and children. May they live to fulfill God's plan. 
May we all arise and fulfill God's assignment to pray in Jesus name. Amen

title: STOP THAT DECEPTION TODAY!
text:
STOP THAT DECEPTION TODAY!
(By Latunde Akin)
A grand deception is going on amongst many churches now.
They like to preach what will increase their membership, but what will scatter those members to go and disciple others. They won't want to preach. 
Some like to preach the finished work of Jesus (salvation) and other added juicy benefits. 
But to preach the unfinished work of Jesus, which is MISSIONS. They won't want to preach it so as to keep cycling their membership because of love for fellowship and benefits of fellowship. 
They forget fellowship isn't the ultimate intention of God,but Missions. Reaching the unreached and discipling all tribes of people. 
Do you know most churches now prefer holding crusades in cities where people are already reached with the gospel. What is the motivating factor around this?
May I tell us that many great men have lost focus. Bible study is good, but what use is Bible study that keeps feeding people to stupor? Much knowledge, less practicalities. Many don't even have Bible study anymore. They would rather sing, motivate,dance, and enjoy speaking in tongue. 
This deception must cease amongst us. if we must become fulfilled by taking the gospel personally to others,we must stop building empires.
Another deception is making merchandise using the church all in the name of establishing businesses. Using religion to make ourselves rich at the expense of doing the real work of missions. 
What is the real work of missions? Focusing on people's need for salvation and discipleship more than focusing on big projects building or big crusades that don't reach places that are yet unreached. 
Brethren, if you won't deceive yourself, you will discover that your brain has been wired to always attend services or programs every day but never to scatter to go places and preach the gospel. 
Romans 15:20  says, "  My ambition has always been to preach the Good News where the name of Christ has never been heard, rather than where a church has already been started by someone else."
From the above,can we see how far we have gone at deceiving ourselves? 
And even those who are trying to scatter themselves into those unreached places, we don't financially support them. We complain by saying that organising big programmes and projects are demanding much finances. So we neglected the real deal just because it's not FASHIONABLE!
God will judge a lot of us this neglect if we don't repent. 
Believer in Christ, please I adjure thee to arise personally in support of missions and missionaries. If you can't go,let your virtues,and your blood go! Your money is your blood! It is your virtues and it speaks louder on the field of souls. That is if you can't go because of your career and work. You can determine to pray for the work as well at a schedule time of the day.
If you're not intentional about doing your part,you're simply wasting your life attending fellowship just to please yourself and not God.
HAVE COMPASSION MISSIONS is dedicated to helping Believers in Christ recognise their urgent need to arise and become burdened with the burden of the Lord to reach out and disciple others like themselves. We have missionaries across the nation we encourage day by day as well.
 As you are led to support them on mission fields or even prepare to go yourself. Simply get in touch with us on WhatsApp 08123428989.
In whichever way,do not let the deception of churchianity gets into your head. The Lord is going to ask you personally about your impact in His kingdom after He had saved you from sin,Satan and sickness. 
In a local government where I know. There are big churches in the town whereas,in the neighbouring settlements of about 169 villages,I was suprised to discover that,there is no gospel around there. The people are starked unbelievers. Yet none of big churches want to go there! 
We should not be decieved. We we reap what we sowed. God is waiting for us to sow in tears of compassion for souls. By this,we are reaping in a great harvest for God. 
Not in deception of FELLOWSHIP in over-ripe places ,but in the penetration of FIELDS that are ripe with genuine gospel outreaches and support. 
God bless everyone who sees sense in this. Amen

title: CAIN WAS BORN AGAIN
text:
CAIN WAS BORN AGAIN
(By Latunde Akin)
I observe how people regard Cain with the disdain reserved for a consummate sinner.
I see how others distance themselves from Cain merely because God disfavored his demeanor.
I witness those in church employing their limited perception and understanding to judge those they deem inadequate.
Abel, Cain's younger brother, born of Adam, was a shepherd, while Cain tilled the land.
Both were familiar with the Lord.
Both worshipped the Lord.
Both maintained a relationship with God.
Both understood the essence of offering their all to God.
Both experienced rebirth according to their enlightenment in transformation at that time. 
THAT WAS A BORN AGAIN EXPERIENCE TOO according to that dispensation pattern. 
Indeed, there are many believers today who are like Cain. Many pastors are like Cain. Numerous church workers resemble Cain.
Many had profound experiences with God, much like Cain. They possess the discernment to sense God's presence. They can ascertain whether their offerings are accepted by God or not too just like Cain. 
Do not tell me Cain was ignorant of God.
Do not suggest he was indolent or idle.
Do not infer that his vocation as a farmer was inferior to being a shepherd.
The mere act of offering his harvest as a sacrifice to God signifies a profound knowledge of Him.
Where did Cain falter?
The scriptures state, "Cain brought some of the fruits of the soil as an offering to the Lord - Genesis 4:3," and "Abel also brought an offering—fat portions from some of the firstborn of his flock... Genesis 4:4."
From the scripture, it is evident that the distinction lies in the word "fat," not "some."
God is not concerned with the quantity of your service in His vineyard. God does not seek the quantity of your sacrifices or offerings.
God desires the quality of your worship or offerings, which is invariably linked to your obedience and the condition of your heart.
Cain's divine encounter was marred by selfishness, covetousness, and a diminished quality of offering. He likely reserved the best for himself, offering the second best to the Lord. Meanwhile, Abel presented his finest.
A secret here 
What truly delights God about our offerings is the heart of obedience, not the gift itself. God perceives either worship or warship in our sacrifices for His glory. Offering a warship to the Lord means being prepared for conflict. Be mindful of the signals you send to heaven. Cain sent the wrong signal, and turmoil persisted in his life. Had he repented, I believe circumstances would have changed.
I personally encountered this recently and repented immediately.
I intended to give an offering and heard the Holy Spirit urging me to give the highest denomination. I disregarded this and gave the second best. Upon leaving the place of worship, all the money in my pocket vanished. I realized I had missed God's desire to offer the best currency. I repented immediately by answering another divine call to bless a missionary, to demonstrate my remorse and learning.
Occasionally, when people give to bless the missionaries, God restrains me from uttering divine words in response to their kindness, beyond a simple thank you. Sometimes, the Spirit moves me to offer intercessory prayers that even stir my envy, wondering why God favors such individuals more than myself. That is the nature of God. He discerns our hearts during our offerings or services.
I now comprehend why Cain erred. 
God valued quality above quantity. 
Cain could have repented but chose jealousy, leading to Abel's murder. Cain became a wanderer, marked for divine vengeance. People feared harming him due to this mark. He lived in spiritual stagnation, dying without repentance. He forfeited his place with God, and Abel's blood continues to speak.
What many fail to realize is that God perceives blood in every form of sacrifice or offering—not mere physical actions or monetary contributions. When Abel offered his fat (not quantity) sacrifice, God sensed the aroma of Abel's labor. When Abel's blood was shed, God witnessed another righteous soul's blood crying for justice. Hence, the blood of Jesus was shed to provide justice for sin and judgment on Satan and his demons.
The currency in the spiritual realm is always blood. Therefore, exercise caution in presenting sacrifices to the Lord. Always offer your best to the Master. Be a living sacrifice, holy and acceptable to the God you worship. Do not squander your life before His altar like Cain, Ananias, and Sapphira.
Cain knew God but lost Him due to his inability to offer his best to his Master.
Are you born again? Understand that being reborn is insufficient. You must continually nurture a heart aligned with His worship.
May you and I not become spiritual wanderers in life's journey. Amen.

title: WHEN GOD MET A LOT OF US AT OUR YONGER AGE
text:
WHEN GOD MET A LOT OF US AT OUR YONGER AGE
(By  Latunde Akin)
When God met a lot of us,we were much younger and our responsibilities were being taken up by either parents or sponsors. 
We met God in an encounter at the cross where our sins were forgiven and the fire of salvation was kindled. We became adopted by God and our journey started.
Then we had no problem with money or pursuit of money. We embraced the Lord from younger age and much more those who discipled us did so well. They taught us how to do Quiet Time,and our growth was directional. People called us S.U just to show we are different from them. 
Yes some believers had it rough from the beginning, they weren't exposed to torough discipleship. Some believers didn't have anyone consistently discipling them, so they had inconsistent doctrinal upbringing.
Discipleship became declining in various churches or gatherings and brethren who were once discipled well stopped discipling others. Many of us who were once on fire for God started another silent movement by  establishing our various colonies where we like to maintain. Colony of spaces where we can find position to rule and get money. 
Brethren God favored in places and companies of influence began to see those opportunities as a means for capitalistic tendencies. Yes,their responsibility has become raised due to need to sustain their immediate family and thus became encumbered with what to eat and drink. 
Churches which were small became so big that they don't have time again for grassroot work of discipleship. 
Projects and expansion techniques have taken over their mindset and the pressure alone is very distracting. 
Programmes that attract crowd became their target and they covered it up with the excuse of doing mass evangelism. 
Process of administration in the church revealed CAPITALISM. A system copied from the government which amasses fund towards the centre. The center now become the focus all because of money. 
Believers lost their sense of decorum as money pumps in to the center, or as they get more comfortable in their various places of work.  They lost their first love. Their first fire became smoke again. Our love for God became sliced into pieces. We still love God,but that love is now being channelled towards becoming more religious than the God of the religion. We love holy parties now than serious decipleship gatherings. 
The church system is being built now in such a way that those who are really doing the work are the one massively suffering. Missionaries are suffering, oh they are suffering. And it is not that there is no money, but believers are spending money on bigger programs and building projects. 
There is a cancerous situation now in the life of many believers that many are not even aware about. It has eaten so deep that they are even ready to support bigger activities at the centre at the neglect of grassroot discipleship of souls. 
If you watch well, people already know they are neglected in various churches. They will just attend service and go home. Nobody is actually interested in their discipleship or care about them. 
A lot of pastors are pastoring nothing. They only write reports, collate papers and only run administration. A lot of them have neglected genuine SHEPHERDING. Discipleship is fast eroding. 
Lust for money,position and fame is covered up by religious activities and services termed FELLOWSHIP. Hmm...fellowship indeed. Fellowship that neglected their brethren on the mission field. Fellowship that has lost her focus of discipling all nations. All that the fellowship is after are CONVERTS. They believe increase in population is DISCIPLESHIP already. They recruit Converts who are not properly discipled into positions or working team. This contributed to a lot of stunted growth. 
Root of all these is actually traced to the negative effect of money. It creeps in subtly  if a believer becomes distracted by its lack or by its accumulation. Lust of the flesh and pride of life. Prosperity gospellers and pentecostal miracle proponents more than the major purpose of Christ caused much more havoc than the good in it. They make believers lost focus of each an everyone discipling others.
A believer is damaged already when he could no more longer disciple another person and instead he is just encumbered with corporate programmes and activities or businesses or work. 
A believer is damaged already when he has lost his original love for God and is now chasing shadows.
A believer is damaged already when his compassion to support Missions,Discipleship and Missionaries is lost. If your church is distracted, you mustn't be personally distracted. 
A believer who has no time to intercede for others on his knees is already damaged. Probably your pursuit for money has damaged you.
At this point, we shouldn't hide from the fact that our lives need repair. 
How will I shy away from that fact? Then it means someone is about to be swallowed up by hell unknowingly if the deception persist. 
Lord, I come to Thee. Please look down from heaven and have mercy on us. Repair our damaged lifestyle and diverted mentality. We surrender to you alone and we refuse the onslaught of lust of our flesh.  Rekindle your fire of love in us,and give us strength to overcome the distraction that lack or lust for money brings. We are returning dear Lord to our first love in Jesus name. Amen

title: HOW TO SPOT HYPOCRISY ANYWHERE
text:
HOW TO SPOT HYPOCRISY ANYWHERE 
(By Latunde Akin)
The most sophisticated instrument of darkness isn't sin of adultery, stealing, worldliness or any physical wrong you can detect. 
It is HYPOCRISY. 
Anything you can easily detect is not as dangerous as anything you cannot detect easily. 
So you should by now understand why discouragement, lukewarmness, distraction, procrastination, doubt and fear are not easily tagged as sin. Simply because they hide under the skin. And they are more dangerous, devastating and evil than those outward sins many people think God has more problems with. 
Reason deception is worst is because those who carries it and those who are manipulated by it may never ever know,except God helps them. Aside those who are purely possessed to intentionally decieve. 
Hypocrisy can be detected by those who are discerning. But no amount of brain work has such capacity to detect it. Suspicion is brainwork, not spirit work. If you keep suspecting, your soul will eventually be lean and weary. You can't sustain your limited perception by just being suspicious, else the devil himself will finish you flat.
1. First understand that every good attitude towards you doesn't mean the person is good. Until you actually know what is powering the goodness. Flesh,God,or Satan. 
God can use anyone for you,but you should be careful Satan can use anyone for you too. So try and spot people who overdo goodness. Anything excessive is not balanced. It may be a cover up.
2. Eye service: once you spot people behaving differently at the back, but show up before people as good. That's a clue of pure deception 
3. You will see people praising someone instead of telling the person what's wrong. Hypocrisy 
4. When you see someone trying to cover up his sin or sin of others. That's Hypocrisy.
5. Backbiters,backstabbers, and rumor mongers. These are category of people who talk too much. 
6. Possessed people are great pretenders. You can't detect them unless by their mistakes and through God opening your inner eye. These people are always looking perfect outwardly. They look so holy but just to decieve. They can be more physically dedicated than the genuine ones just to cover up. But they make mistakes too,and only the discerning will not just commonise such mistakes.  There is always a great tendency for people who don't see beyond their nose to trivialise such mistakes. 
And you know one funny thing?
This last category must be handled with greater wisdom. There is a weapon you don't only use to fight them. You don't use only weapon of power. You will use weapon of wisdom, strategy and the word. Weapon of love can work for the first four category but your love can't deliver a possessed man. You will need warfare,and the best wars are won not by power,but by both wisdom (strategy)and power. 
It's very easy to seperate from wrong people but not from wrong spirit. Infact, spirit of hypocrisy doesn't repent. 
So it takes only God to deliver such people through any means He wants to use.
If you look closely, you will discover diplomacy is not near hypocrisy. Being diplomatic is simply a strategy to relate with people without hurting them. Hypocrites end result is to hurt without being detected. Anything you can study in school is not hypocrisy. Diplomacy is a study which can be used in both a good way or bad way. It shouldn't be mixed up with hypocrisy which is a spirit.
The church denominations are mostly filled with Hypocrites. Many business offices too are filled with them. We shouldn't only think of churches, we shouldn't be decieved to think Hypocrites are only interested in churches. That's a big lie.
Our duty is to simply align properly with God in serious fellowship, consecration and holiness. So that we can escape the trap Hypocrites set all around and much more,so that God can use us to rescue or reduce them. 
God bless you for comprehending. 
May we not fall into self deception. May we not cover our sins. In Jesus name. Amen

title: ANGER TEST: MY EXPERIENCE
text:
ANGER TEST: MY EXPERIENCE
( By Latunde Akin)
If you still get angry over every slightest provocation or offence. You don't know what a great loss that has befallen you.
If you are always angry at someone, even when all evidence shows that you are right to get angry. You don't know a great trap you have fallen into.
If you are a type that can't be easily pacified or calmed when you are angry. You don't know how much of great instrument you are to the devil.
Anger is not actually the sin. God gets angry too. The sin of anger is when it's not achieving the will of God's kingdom. When your anger smells SELF. When you exhibit self in disguise of fighting for God. When your anger lacks the honor of God. And unless you're highly sensitive in the spirit, you can't ever discern the thin line between the one that's of God's will. 
For example, Jesus rebuked the devil speaking through Peter's mouth. Paul rebuked Peter's double measure attitude. Paul was angry at that sorcerer who proclaimed truth about Paul's anointing. Believers get angry at sin.etc. And didn't do any of these to satisfy SELF.
Few days ago,I was making a request from my wife. She was doing yanga,(she wasn't taking me seriously). Then I began to let her know that her insensitivity, unresponsive attitude was not good. And probably as a result of evil arrow that wants to hinder good things and ensure we fight. I actually hit her with that insight,so she became unhappy. 
You see,the target was actually me. The whole ploy of the devil was to make me angry so that what God wanted to do in Spirit can be suspended. At that period,I had been praying to God for certain deliverance but,the spiritual enemy had seen my anger will never allow God to do it. 
Moment I recognized the imminent behavior of my wife at that time,I had to open up to her that she should be careful not to allow the devil to use her make me angry. Then she in turn became angry and started to excuse our bedroom to another room. In disguise that she wanted to go and pray. She actually prayed,but refused to come up to the room where I was.
Quietly after some time I stood to go and lift her , blessed her with sweet words and hold her  to come to the room to sleep.
That singular act endeared God to embrace me overnight. 
And one funny thing was that,I wasn't even aware that night was the night God had prepared to answer my prayers. I passed the test of anger.
Then,the miraculous happened that same night. I had an encounter with God. And encounter that can't be said here. I became an instrument of blessing. If I say "God bless you" to anyone jokingly, the person is blessed. I was also delivered from certain hindrances that night. Just simply because I handled the situation of what has come to test my character well. 
Oh that men in Christ will begin to handle angry situations well to the glory of God. And allow such situation to give honor to God rather than flesh or self. This will always make God to trust us more with certain specific authorities and also deliver us from our many troubles.
You and I must understand that anger is a sign that good thing is around our corner. When God is about to answer all our prayers, devil will always want to send his monitoring spirits around us to instigate even closest people to make us get angry for self defense without processing whether it's to God's honor or not. Thus prolonging and postponing our divine encounter or blessings.
May you receive understand now. 
May you amend your ways 
May the answers to all your prayers manifest.
May you restitute with those you are getting angry at, manage those who are causing you to get angry, and make peace with those who are angry at you. All to the glory of God. 
May you pass anger test.Amen

title: The man who wrote How to Save Your Marriage shot his wife and posted the photograph online.
text:
The man who wrote How to Save Your Marriage shot his wife and posted the photograph online.
Dale Carnegie taught the world how to win friends, then died alone.
Benjamin Spock reshaped modern parenting. His own sons tried to place him in a nursing home.
Maria Montessori built an entire philosophy around nurturing children and gave her own son to be raised by others.
A Korean author who sold millions of copies of How to Be Happy lived for years with depression and later took her own life.
an-Jacques Rousseau wrote tenderly about virtue and education, then sent all 5 of his children to an orphanage.
Leo Tolstoy preached simplicity and moral clarity while his home fractured under bitterness and conflict.
Napoleon Hill promised success through positive thinking and died disgraced and financially ruined.
Ayn Rand condemned public aid as moral failure, then depended on it in old age.
This is not coincidence.
People who sell answers are often still bleeding from the questions.
And it does not stop with self-help.
Religion has its own record.
Jim Bakker preached family values and prosperity, then went to prison for fraud.
Jimmy Swaggart thundered against sexual sin and later confessed to living it.
Ted Haggard led a massive church while living a double life.
Ravi Zacharias spoke beautifully about truth. After his death, credible investigations revealed a private life that betrayed those words.
If i want to add Nigerian names ..the list would be very long
Different stages. Same fracture.
Public certainty.
Private collapse.
This is what happens when authority is mistaken for holiness, when image replaces accountability, when teaching becomes performance.
So listen carefully.
Do not treat authority as infallible.
Titles do not cure brokenness.
Platforms do not confer integrity.
Truth can pass through flawed people.
But flawed people should never be enthroned.
Use books, sermons, and teachers as tools.
Not as substitutes for discernment.
Not as permission to stop thinking.
And then there is Jesus Christ.
I have read more than 3000 books…
Personally, He is the only teacher I have read whose life does not contradict His words.
He did not explain sacrifice. He bore it.
He did not talk about humility. He knelt, washed feet, and carried the cross.
Scripture states it without decoration:
Acts of the Apostles 1:1
Jesus began first to do, and then to teach.
That order matters.
Clarity can be borrowed.
Character cannot.

title: "IFURA LOOGUN AGBA"
text:
"IFURA LOOGUN AGBA" 
Watchfulness is the senior brother of Prayer. 
By Latunde Akin 
If you are not a person who is both spiritually and physically observant. You will enter into a trap of people who are simply out there to steal,kill and destroy and you won't still know.
This is because such people smile always and are most of the time friendly. They build your trust in them with the mind to later strike at a time you won't be able to escape or least expected.
If you don't build your capacity in God now,it will definitely show after such people strike. You don't have to offend such people before they strike.
Infact you can be very good to them,and it doesn't mean that they won't still want to fulfill their evil target. 
You can't change them by your good doing. Just that you must still keep doing good because that's part of what God will use to defend you when your obedience is complete.
Reason I said doing good isn't enough is because
 The presence of IGNORANCE in any person doing good has that capacity to neutralize the good he is doing. Destruction is what always follows lack of knowledge which is ignorance.
Your keen observation about whatever is going on around you is called WATCHFULNESS. This is a duty from God to everyone just like PRAYER.
There was someone I was praying and interceeding for. Oh you will think she's genuinely seeking God's intervention. I went to her with other ministers and on getting there,she gave us bottled water to drink. I told them to keep the water in the car and never to drink anything. Others didn't know what happened till today,I didn't tell them unless they are reading from here.
After we finished the Intercession and dispatched everyone. All the bottles were punctured on their cap cover. You understand now, another substance was inside the water and it would have been a bad situation if not for God's help to practically observe.
Another incidence is with a close family member who brought raw foods and coconuts for us as part of visiting gift. As I thanked him and after the whole visit. I told my wife to bring everything they brought so we can pray on them. As I was praying with eyes opened,I observed the coconut well and discovered all of them were pierced at the one of the 3 dots on top of them and were perfectly corked with wood so the water inside them can't spill out. I showed my wife and she was literally shaking.We have to discard them all.
What am I saying? This is the very reason why a lot of people are sick and they don't know the source. I mean terrible sickness that their treatment takes only God or huge spending on medical solutions. Something that should have been avoided by keen observation or watchfulness. 
Yoruba people used to say " ifura loogun agba".
"Watchfulness is the medicine of mature people ".
You don't live your life suspecting people. You don't live in suspicion. This is going to weary you out. 
Watchfulness is your ability to be alive in God and practically detect danger or traps before time and avoid them still smiling without destroying good relationships. Suspicion will make you destroy good relationships. That is the difference.
May your spiritual man become so developed to be watchful. May mercy locate all of us always.
Prayer is for curing. Watchfulness is for preventing.
 So watch and pray. Your guardian angel you must hear. In the midst of woes you are. Watch and Pray!
Your brother

It pained me and I couldn't contain it,so I tried to give it back without success. 
I had to park the car because I was driving when it happened. Yet I wasn't successful at giving it back. 
I became a rascal man that day and you won't imagine that  situation actually revealed I wasn't a gentleman at all. 
What started as a play turned me to a spray 
.
Come and see drama that day. Nobody could calm me ,not even the Holy Spirit. I lost the Holy Spirit that day and regained Him thereafter. 
That was many many years ago anyways. 
Hear me well, and I want people to understand something. 
Marriage is actually not what you see in pictures. 
Marriage is not what people see being displayed outside.
Marriage is two people working on themselves together and allowing both comfort and conflict to mold them to become better. 
If you only grow in comfort all the time,you're not growing. 
That's why I will never advise couples not to have disagreement, they should be free to express their grievances and never hide nonsense. Else pretending to manage nonsense can lead to more destruction that may become permanent. 
I personally don't believe preachers who says its all comfort all throughout their marriage journey. They are liars or just wanted to show people they are perfect. 
I can authoritatively tell people now that I have learned through experience how to manage my wife better and endure the hormonal/menstrual things that used to make women behave somehow. Women go through a lot inside but a lot of men don't know.

Do not try to prove yourself right always, but be very strong as a man. A strong man is what a woman needs so they can feel protected,not just a soft soul. 
Yes,you may once be rascal like mine,but please don't allow that rascality continue. Keep it for fighting evil strangers. Keep it for spirituality and not for physical abuse. Keep it for the day of battle and not for proofing your rights. 
I
Much more, in the kingdom of darkness, they do shoot arrows of anger into marriages and couples will never suspect. 
Be very sensitive to know when not to dance to the tune of arrows of disagreement, anger and misbehaviour. 
Do not let anyone decieve you,no marriage is perfect physically. But we have the peace of God when we manage it well.  The good management is what some calls perfect. 
You can now understand why marriages are facing problems? 
 Bad management. 
Today, please reconcile with your partner at all cost,and never try to keep offences for long time. 
May God keep our home. Amen 
Your brother

title: DANGOTE REFINERY IPO: BEFORE YOU BUY, UNDERSTAND WHAT ₦525 REALLY MEANS
text:
DANGOTE REFINERY IPO: BEFORE YOU BUY, UNDERSTAND WHAT ₦525 REALLY MEANS
Over the past few days, quite a number of clients, friends and associates have asked me what I think about the Dangote Refinery IPO and whether I believe they should invest.
Rather than simply say “buy” or “don't buy”, I decided to look closely at the numbers and share the most important facts I believe anyone considering the IPO should understand.
Because there is an important distinction we sometimes miss:
Dangote Refinery may become one of Africa's greatest businesses and its shares could still be expensive.
Both statements can be true.
That is why I would neither tell anyone to buy this IPO nor tell anyone to avoid it.
I would rather put the important numbers on the table.
WHAT EXACTLY IS BEING SOLD?
As I write this on 10 September 2026, the IPO has not opened yet. It is scheduled to open on 14 September and close on 13 October 2026.
The offer price is ₦525 per share.
The minimum application is 10 shares, meaning you can participate with ₦5,250.
Dangote Petroleum Refinery is issuing 4.1 billion NEW shares.
At ₦525 each, the company intends to raise: ₦2.1525 trillion
Using today's market exchange rate of roughly ₦1,323 to $1, that is approximately: $1.63 billion.
Notice the word NEW.
This is principally an offer for subscription. Existing shareholders are not simply selling 4.1 billion of their shares and taking the ₦2.15 trillion home.
The money raised goes into the company, primarily to support its expansion plans.
Now here is the part many people may not realise
Before the IPO, Dangote Refinery has approximately 120.13 billion shares.
After issuing the 4.1 billion new shares, that becomes approximately 124.23 billion shares.
Therefore, this base IPO represents only about: 3.3% of the enlarged company.
Yes.
For all the noise around one of Africa's biggest IPOs, the base offer represents approximately 3.3% of Dangote Refinery after the new shares are issued.
And there is another interesting detail...
An investment vehicle has already committed up to $400 million, representing roughly a quarter of the 4.1 billion share offer. Once that is spread across the full enlarged company, though, it comes to less than 1% of Dangote Refinery overall.
So the portion genuinely available to the wider market could be even smaller than the headline offer suggests.
If demand exceeds supply, the company is permitted, subject to SEC approval, to absorb up to 30% more shares than the original offer.
So how much does Aliko Dangote actually own?
This also needs clarification.
The approximately 66% you may see beside Dangote Oil Refining Company Limited is not Aliko Dangote's total economic interest.
His disclosed beneficial interest is spread across several entities.
Before the IPO, his disclosed beneficial interest is approximately 87.27%.
After the base IPO dilution, it remains approximately 84%.
So buying shares gives the public economic participation in the refinery
It does not substantially change control.
Aliko Dangote will remain overwhelmingly in control of the company.
For context, NNPC currently owns about 6.8%. So if you have seen a figure around 7%, that is much closer to NNPC's holding than Dangote's beneficial interest.
Now let us talk about the ₦525 price
After the base IPO, approximately 124.23 billion shares at ₦525 imply a market capitalisation of roughly: ₦65.2 trillion
At today's exchange rate, approximately: $49 billion.
Dangote's continuing beneficial interest alone would therefore have an implied value of roughly ₦55 trillion, or approximately $41.6 billion, based purely on the IPO valuation.
That is not cash in his pocket. It is the implied market value of that shareholding.
Now comes the real investment question.
IS A ROUGHLY $49 BILLION VALUARION EXPENSIVE?
On a simple international refinery comparison, it certainly looks rich.
S Oil in South Korea has refining capacity of about 669,000 barrels per day and a current market capitalisation around $13 billion to $15 billion.
HF Sinclair in the United States has about 678,000 barrels per day of refining capacity and is worth about $19 billion.
Tüpraş in Turkey operates about 30 million tonnes of annual refining capacity across four refineries and has a market capitalisation around $16.5 billion.
Dangote has completed performance testing at its original 650,000 barrel daily design capacity and has since processed as much as 700,000 barrels per day, yet the IPO implies an equity value of roughly $49 billion.
On that simple comparison, Dangote looks expensive.
But this is exactly where simplistic analysis should stop.
Capacity is NOT valuation.
Two refineries processing similar quantities of crude can have completely different profitability, complexity, product mix, debt, growth prospects and cash generation.
Dangote also has petrochemicals, access to a huge domestic market, substantial export potential, a relatively sophisticated refinery configuration and plans to expand to approximately 1.4 million barrels per day by 2029.
And the recent financial performance is significant.
The refinery reported approximately $1.82 billion profit in the first half of 2026, compared with a $476 million loss for 2025.
It also generated about $2.6 billion EBITDA during those six months.
That is serious earnings power.
But it raises another question.
How much of that profitability is sustainable when global refining margins normalise?
This is why I would be careful about simply declaring the IPO overvalued.
CardinalStone Research has estimated a 12 month value of about ₦77.7 trillion, with a target price of ₦688.09 per share.
Chapel Hill Denham has estimated fair equity value at about ₦82.6 trillion, significantly above the IPO's roughly ₦65.2 trillion implied valuation.
In other words, some professional analysts looking beyond refinery capacity believe ₦525 could actually offer upside.
They may be right
They may be wr0ng
That is what markets are for.
So what should a serious investor actually study?
• Whether the extraordinary 2026 profits are sustainable
• Free cash flow, not simply revenue or accounting profit
• The approximately $5.67 billion indebtedness reported as at June 2026
• Crude oil supply security and cost
• Refining margins and how sensitive profits are to them
• The execution and financing of the planned $14.3 billion expansion
• Foreign exchange exposure
• Regulatory and government policy risk
• Related party transactions and corporate governance
• Dividend prospects
• Minority shareholder protection
• And ultimately, the return that ₦525 can reasonably produce over your investment horizon.
What should matter much less?
That it is Dangote
That your friends are buying
That people expect the shares to jump immediately after listing
That it is Africa's largest refinery
Or that you are frightened of missing out.
NONE of those tells you whether ₦525 represents good value.
Dangote Refinery is an extraordinary Nigerian and African industrial achievement.
That deserves recognition.
But investment requires a different question.
A great business is not automatically a great investment
A great business bought at the wrong price can become a p00r investment
A r!sky business bought at the right price can sometimes become an excellent one.
So before you ask:
"Do I believe in Dangote?"
Ask the more useful question:
"Do the sustainable earnings, cash flows, r!sks and future growth of this business justify paying ₦525 per share and valuing it at about ₦65 trillion?"
That is the question a serious investor should be trying to answer.
Investment begins where admiration ends and the numbers begin.
Which number in this post changed how you were thinking about the IPO? Tell me in the comments.
- Abiodun Adetula

title: STORY OF A MISSIONARY
text:
STORY OF A MISSIONARY 
He drank cassava garri for a whole month and slept on woonden bench for three months. 
A missionary who was deployed to Anambra state at a time recounted his ordeal. 
He was sent to Awka suburb from Southwest to spread the gospel and disciple. But on getting there the church headquarters stopped support. He became stranded and has to begin to find his own means of survival. 
He didn't know anyone, and his contact person couldn't accommodate him. The arrangement was that they will send accommodation fund to him as soon as he gets to the mission field.
Without knowing the sender church will dissapoint,he went and was met with lack of support. 
He narrated how he suffered by drinking garri  everyday for  1 month.
He was denied support for 3 months and he suffered terribly because the sender church weren't available anymore. 
When asked why they neglected him or decieved him into going without proper arrangement. He responded they changed the plan or weren't just able to meet up again.
Yet he won about 5 souls and discipled them.
Yes the situation wasn't palatable and even dissapointing to him,but he sacrificed it for the sake of positive impact. 
He didn't complain, he didn't murmur,he didn't blame anybody. He endured such hardness as a good soldier of Christ and made sure he laboured to get 5 new souls for Christ. 
The worth of a man isn't known by his reaction against hurt,but by his ability to channel the hurt in a positive way for positive impact. 
You can't compare such a man by quantity of church members but by quality of service rendered for the Lord's sake out of discomfort.  And that is why his 5 souls for the Lord might be far greater than a thousand souls who are simply benchwarmers. 
If you know what it takes to go hungry for months just because those who God sent to send you disappointed. You will always appreciate genuine missionaries who suffered to spread the gospel message. 
If I may ask you too,what are you suffering on in your life so that others may be impacted positively?
Begin to think about what you too can sacrifice as a believer in Christ so others could be reached and rescued for God. Don't just live,live impactful life.
Begin to consecrate your time,your skills and yourself on the altar of service. 
Would there be any stars in your crown?
Think about this and change today. 
Your brother,
Latunde Akin

It's a time of sacrifice where God can see your consistency and help you. 
It is a time you would have finished your meeting with God before they started their own meeting. 
It is a time God always regard because it's not a convenient time to pray for people who has been tired from day work. 
We have spent 716 days  praying together at 11pm. (Intercessory is 852days) You too can join us using the link in the comment section. 
We make sure we pray very well on just a prayer theme for 1 or 2 weeks, sometimes 3 weeks. 
As you join us in the prayer train, may you experience a good paradigm shift. 
Please also pray for the woman with 4 years pregnancy. That she would deliver safely and quickly in Jesus name. Amen.

title: PITY OR COMPASSION: WHICH IS BETTER?
text:
PITY OR COMPASSION: WHICH IS BETTER? 
(By Latunde Akin)
My wife was pregnant of our twin girls and my parent felt they should assist with finances since I ost my good job on my wedding day.
Out of pity they travelled to visit so they can motivate me to buy children things before birth of the children. So they extended their good hands to give me this bundle of money. 
To a normal wired person, the next thing is to collect it.
I didn't actually collect it. I told them straightaway that I can't collect it. That they should keep their money. 
I asked them if it's their own parents that bought children things for them during their time? They answered no. Then why wouldn't they allow me to buy my children things by myself without any assistance? They looked at me with amazement and left.
You see,I have come to understand a particular principle of help. That's why you don't see me accepting any kind of help. 
I rejected my parent's gift of money not because I didn't need it. Not because I wanted to disrespect them.  But because I understood that they were doing it out of pity. 
Principle of help states that any help done to you out of pity would make your soul lean and not fat. 
Any help done to you because of pity will not become a blessing to you and the giver. 
Any help done to you because of pity has high probability of sending you back into a comfort zone where your own creative ability is limited or put in a relaxed mode.
Help is good but you must recognise when not to accept to be helped by pity. Pity mustn't be your helper. It may look good and soothing but you may be tempted to relax from creating something good out of bad experiences. 
Your help must only come from God. And it won't come because God is pitying you. Pitying is different from compassion. Compassion has positive energy powering it. Pity has a very negative force or energy powering it. And  you don't need such negative energy to prosper.
There was a time a friend gave 100k,(18 years ago  or thereabouts)to do business. He gave it so i can return it back. I didn't ask for it,but he felt I was suffering too much and he needed to simply help out. He knows I am business savvy but he wouldn't understand why I decided to do nothing than to tell everyone I was praying. That prayer was my job then.  He pitied me and this was how I knew it
.
After collecting the money, he then said it was his mother that pressurised him to help me. His mother told him that he shouldn't keep watching me like that as his friend.  At that moment, I discovered the background as to why he decided to give the money without me asking for it. I simply discovered he did it out of pity and not really out of compassion. 
Yes,to a normal person, that's a good thing to do. Which I dearly appreciated. But I took the matter to the Lord in prayers and began to cry before God. I said Lord, if this is not a help from you I don't want.  Give me my own job.
In the same month, I got a job with official car. So I returned his money to him in the same month. I didn't use it again as God provided job for me already. Much more it was lended to be returned. My friend however did something wonderful, he gave me 20k out of it free of charge to enjoy with. 
Don't get me wrong, my parents and my friend did what they felt was right, but it wasn't right at that time before God. Because it was laced with pity.
You don't pity a man who is right with God and isn't lazy. 
You don't pity people, you should rather HAVE COMPASSION ON THEM. 
When you have genuine compassion on people, the power powering it will always be from God and not from the flesh. 
You can even pity a carnal man without God. But a poor Lazarus has a better future than you pitying him. You should be very careful when you are dealing with a spiritual man. He doesn't need pity. He needs genuine compassion and it's eventually for your own good. Because you will definitely meet that poor Lazarus on the other side where what you have done to him will eventually speak for you. 
It is not everyone that Jesus healed during his days on earth but only those God directed him to. Yes God loves everyone but emotions don't rule him. He is not a flesh, and if He helps you or moves anyone to help you, you will recognise its not going to be out of pity.
God's compassion on us sometimes come in form of rigorous training through bad experiences. It's not only in good deeds to us he manifest compassion, but even the bad situation can be the compassion if we are sensitive enough. Reason we must not allow anyone to pity us out of such tough training that look like bad experience. 
May parents had good motive ,my friend had good motive. Just that such good motives were not good enough for at that time. And it's only a man who is man enough or highly discerning that can stand against what pity was about to do in his life.
This differs from pride please. You must understand how not to be proud before God and men. I became actually proud at a point, believing so much in hardwork until God broke me to pieces and shattered my ego. Then God Himself couldn't send help to me,the help will hate itself.
 But not anymore, I have been taught by God after picking my shattered ego together. I now understand hardwork is only the foundation for divine help. No man can succeed only by hardwork but with help of God called grace.
At a point God opened my inner eye to understand that for everyone He sent to help me,it's because He wants to help them too. And this is because I have made myself an altar for Him. An altar where sacrifices are made unto Him everyday in intercession for the church,and souls. You can be an alter too for God. You shouldn't just be a living sacrifice, turn yourself to an altar where living sacrifices are made unto God. Be the blessing.
God is emotional, He feels, He loves,He is compassionate. But He is not controlled by emotions. He doesn't pity. He is a just God. He knows the exact time to train people and when not to train them. If He sends you to help people, it is mostly for your own good and not because of pity but out of compassion. 
Men who are chickens are people who who recieve pity and look out for people to pity them.
It is better to cry out loud to God for His compassion, so He can send genuine help. A genuine helper won't pity you because they are under God's control. 
A Christian who is in God is thus full of compassion. Rescue the perishing. Do good always. And doesn't circumvent God's process of training people all in the name of compassion which is simply pity.
Is pity not good at all? Yes it's good for the chickens. But for the mature,chastisement with  creativity could be compassion. 
This doesn't mean you should see people drowning and not rescue them if you can. 
To have pity is also a good quality at the level of humanity. 
Do not allow the humanity inside you to die before you leave the scene. 
May we discern properly. 
.

title: CHURCH AND HYPOCRISY
text:
CHURCH AND HYPOCRISY 
(By Latunde Akin)
One thing I detest in church is hypocrisy.
A leader will see what's wrong and still close his mouth all because if he talks, money won't flow again. 
You will see a wrong system of administration operating in a church and people will all keep following like goats. All because of fear of man and the benefits they are getting from such wrong system. 
I happen to be a trained missionary and as I entered a particular ministry. The Lord opened my inner eye to see all the people surrounding the church leader. I saw head of goats, ram,snake and chicken on those people and I began to shake.  These are pastors, ministers and workers, not just stark unbelievers.
The Lord began to tell me those people I see are hypocrites. They are double faced. They are not what people think they are. Yet they are the most serious set of church people. 
The Lord simply told me, I should not follow any of those people. I should only look unto Jesus, the author and the finisher of my faith. 
Then in my mind  I began to question a lot of things. Why the Lord sent me there? What to do? And how to navigate things. Clearly I was told I couldn't do anything and I was just sent there to learn how not to create a system filled with hypocrisy around myself. 
These days, it is very hard to meet people in church who are not predenders. If any don't want to pretend, the system their leader created will force them to pretend. 
As a leader, you don't create fear of you to your followers or create a system which breeds fear in people. Yes,Jesus was a simple man of God and at the same time approachable. He related smoothly with his disciples to an extent an external person won't know their difference. He maintained an open style which even wicked people can't hide under except Judas,a son of perdition.
I have personally believed church is a place where pretence shouldn't be encouraged all in the name of practicing religion. Not that agents of darkness won't be found, but that the fire should be so enough to expose them rather to encouraging them to thrive through our corrupted style of administration. 
To hell with your money, if it would make me to manage you as a pretender. It is far better to tell you the truth gracefully and let the fire of God deal with you than to keep quiet when I see something wrong. 
To hell with every pretender in church if they refuse to repent now or show their true colours. 
I don't know why many just like to pretend to be who they are not.
Well,I think that's a characteristic of the devil too. He appears as an angel of light to decieve many inorder to be able to wreck havoc so deeply without people knowing. 
You will see that most church leaders in this country don't have any capacity again to correct government and political leaders. They have been silenced with billions. Mega projects are the focus ,not the people God sent them to anymore. 
Missionaries under them are suffering while they are concerned with big donations from government leaders who in turn steal those monies. And the power in their words are of no more effect. Thus most members under them are becoming pretenders.
Yes there are still remnants who are never hypocrites. But they are hard to find or not obvious. 
To me,I think God is rather waiting for those remnants to rise to the tasks ahead of them. And until a generation passes, may be their time will come to establish what no corrupt person can silence with money. 
Much more God is expecting the church to also get involved in practical nation building and not just church services. 
Religion is not actually a scam. It's the people that is scam. 
I stand to be corrected. 
May all hypocrites repent.  Amen

title: HOW I GOT MARRIED.
text:
HOW I GOT MARRIED.
(By Latunde Akin)
Anyone that will marry you won't stress you.
Forget about ladies or men who try to stress you thinking by stressing you,you will value them more. That's a wrong principle, a wrong mentality. 
I remembered trying to stress myself over certain ladies and they eventually rejected. The one that didn't reject ,we still didn't marry because stress or no stress isn't the only determinant of success in marriage proposal. 
I have simply come to realise at a point that the peace God gives when you meet people is what matters most. Not the peace you or they think they can give.
My younger sister got wedded and I happened to attend her wedding as big brother. I saw this lady behind her as best lady,so my eye started to roll. I called my younger sister and asked about her. Before that time I had proposed to another sister who rejected the proposal. But I insisted to remain focused and resolute till I see the sister I proposed to, to marry before jumping on another. That was the kind of mindset I had then. No wasn't No to me. I will rather kpai there until I see no reason to kpai there again. That ibo sister showed me pepper 
 
I waited and waited for the sister to marry, she didn't. I actually believed I would be the one to marry her despite her reject. But it got to a point I broke down in tears before the Lord. I wept in prayers for a whole day locking myself up in the room.  Studying the book of Ruth and weeping in prayer. Then the light shined upon my heart. I repented of trying to use my own wisdom and skills. Then my mind remembered the best lady to my younger sister which I had already admired casually. 
At that point, I decided to test myself by confirming if my mind was thinking right. I determined never to approach her or show her any of my interest. I went straight to tell the marriage committee of the church. Pastor Odemona asked her church and address from me. I didn't know it,so he collected her phone contact and called her right in my presence. She wasn't a member of the church I attended then,but only attended campus fellowship where my younger sister met her. 
Everything went so smoothly with the church committee and the sister didn't know it's me until the day I proposed. 
Something else happened,I secretly traced and discussed with her mentor,pastor which I saw on her CV. I didn't just believe my mind was communicating God's will. I needed to make personal research too to confirm it. If it doesn't tally,I wouldn't have just believed blindly. Faith isn't against common sense. Her pastor showed me exactly that I am safe. He handled her straight into 29 days fasting for God to show her the man to marry. He didn't tell her it's me. 
On the day my church gave me go ahead to propose to her was the day she was concluding her 29 days white fast. She saw me clearly and went to her pastor to tell him. The pastor then told her I am the one that privately came to him. That he wants her to see the man by herself and not him revealing the man. 
A day after,I appeared to propose and it was all smooth. She didn't even allow me to say much. No stress,not hustle, no friction. She was already prepared for it by her pastor who puts her through serious spiritual drilling. 
Then we began courtship. Then another thing strucked. I lost the job I was doing then. Spiritual attack started and I decided to face it on squarely. I left for the prayer bushes. I became wretched jobwise but remained stubborn praying for the next two years till God answered my prayers. 
You could imagine I didn't have time for the woman, no serious organised courtship because all my time was spent in the bushes of prayer. Nothing romantic when a man is facing spiritual battle. Throughout she stood with me without shaking. She was convinced I am her husband. She didn't bother about material things a man should have that i didn't have. She was aware I wasn't a lazy man, I was doing well at the time I proposed, but battle dragged me back to lose nearly everything. And since I was rugged enough to face it squarely in prayers, she knew something good will come out of it.
After 2 years headon praying, I was called by a company and given a job with an official car. 
Quickly we got married. 
.
The story of the wedding is for another day. Because, I wore my 2 year old black jacket and shoe. I didn't buy any new jacket. And at that time I was in Apostolic Faith Church already. 
Listen, you should never bother about what people say about you than what God is saying. 
You should never compare your journey with another’s journey because you are not fighting thesame battle. 
You should always understand how never to get involved in anything shady against your church marriage rules because on the long run, the devil will use it to stand against you spiritually. Always be sincere and your sincerity will always fight for you. 
Mistakes are part of life, so do not condemn yourself when that relationship didn't work. Be humble about it and genuinely repent before the Lord for making such mistakes so He can help you put your pieces together. Yes God will if you are humble enough. 
God isn't interested in people without focus,but people who won't double date. Double dating is a clear signal that you're unreliable for a divine help.
Be patient with people, show impact. It's not a good thing that you're only interested in people because you want to marry them. You can always sow seed of impact with no strings attached. Which God will see and use to make a way for you in His own way. (Aside manipulation).
May we learn. 
May the peace of God reigns in our marriages. 
God bless.

title: GOD IS TELLING YOU TO WEEP FOR THEIR SOUL.
text:
GOD IS TELLING YOU TO WEEP FOR THEIR SOUL.
HARVEST IS PLENTY, LABORERS ARE FEW.
(By Latunde Akin) 
There are crocodile tears,. 
There are compassionate tears. 
There is a kind of sorrowful weeping. 
There is a kind for joy. 
There is a kind of weeping that moves the entire heaven.
There is a type that can't even move a mosquito. In fact if your tears are too salty sef, mosquitoes will come around to taste it.
Weeping is an instrument of emotional expression and communication which speaks volumes than words. 
The deepest kind of prayer is a type that is done with GROANINGS WHICH CANNOT BE UTTERED. This is far and more deeper than even speaking in tongues. At least you are speaking something when you speak in tongues. But groaning is another level entirely deeper than that. That's the kind I meant as weeping. 
I pray that the Lord helps His children to grow up to this level. Amen. 
Scriptural texts 
 John 11:33-36, 2 Chronicles 34 :27. 
Jesus wept in John 11:35. Lazarus was dead and they told Jesus. He wept and rose Lazarus from the grave. His weeping sent a clear cut message to heaven. 
Can God respect and respond to our tears like that? 
Abraham sent Hagar and the lad away with only one bottle of water and a bread. Both of them were crying looking for water but the Bible says God heard the cry of the lad and not that of his mother. 
Can your cry be heard at all by the Lord over a situation that warrant rescue of yourself or someone?
Let us tell ourselves this truth please. Are we not becoming so harden in the heart as a result of disobedience to the Lord about the Great commission?
A reward for every disobedience is surely a reprobate heart. And a reprobate heart God can never regard, respect or respond to no matter how the weeping endures.
Weeping may endure for a night.... is never applicable to reprobate hearts. If you like, keep weeping in disobedience, no Lazarus will wake from the grave around you. You are only making devils to rejoice more by your tears into their calabash for donations
But there is a groaning that the devil fears. A groaning in the Spirit over souls of men. 
A genuine compassion for the lost
A humble heart that weeps before the Lord day and night for the salvation of souls.
A broken spirit and a contrite heart.... God can't despise. 
Believers in Christ, where art thou?
Is your heart of compassion now dead?
Are you going to remain like that?
You have been disobeying the Lord all these while and your reward has been a dead hardened reprobate heart.
If we stop that disobedience today, I am sure our God is faithful to restore us back to where we started at Calvary. He will restore our genuine lost tears back.
OUR DISOBEDIENCES. 
1. We can't go ye again to preach the gospel.
2. No more striving for mastery in spiritual exercises and in God. 
3. We take pleasure in socializing more than the work of rescuing souls. 
4. We can no more groan in the Spirit. We have lost our encounters. 
5. We love to be busy in the church at the expense of lost souls. We care more about the 99 left than the 1 lost.
6. We left the field of souls for the wolves. 
7. The harvest is plenty, but the few laborers are sleeping on duty. 
8. We have become like the religious Jew and the good Samaritan in us is dead.
9. Instead to humble ourselves and weep before the Lord, we are in turn making the Lord to weep from heaven over our unprofitable lives.
10. We keep crucifying the Lord Jesus over and over again by not living a lifestyle of love that can win others. We take delight in Pulpit or speaking without showing the lifestyle.
Many may think God does not weep too. How can the God who created us in His image put emotions in us to feel and He will not be touched by the infirmities  of those He created? Nay.
He is always touched too. He feels too. He experiences sorrow too over the people He created.
Hebrews 4:15 
For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin.
We need to arise and pray for the peace of Jerusalem. 
We need to weep for the soul of men by interceding for them in our closets. 
God is looking for intercessors. Will ye be one?
God is looking for men who would have compassion to rescue others from the valley of sin.Will ye be counted worthy?
God is looking for laborers who would not be sleeping a spiritual sleep of death.Will your dry bones receive life?
God is looking for you. Yes you that you are reading this. Will God find you or you remain unfound?
Oh that my head were waters, and mine eyes a fountain of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people! (Jeremiah 9:1) 
Oh that God will find me and you faithful to arise and begin to ask for mercy upon our souls that are like dry bones. To receive life afresh and go out immediately in search of the missing sheep.
As for me, my mind is made up, gazed up, my eyes fixed upon the cross, to obey and to carry. That my siblings, neighbors and friends who are getting lost may be saved. No turning back, no turning back. I have decided. 
How about you?
Let us pray.....
Jesus, restore our dry bones, that we may live again to fulfill the great commission. Restore our lost and dried tears, the kind that is regarded in heaven and not in hell. In Jesus name we pray. Amen.

title: 15 years ago, when I saw Intercessory Ministries in Nigeria turning to Prophetic Houses, and I saw those that use to gather periodically to …
text:
15 years ago, when I saw Intercessory Ministries in Nigeria turning to Prophetic Houses, and I saw those that use to gather periodically to cry to God for revival in the land now gathering to promise people cars, visas, wedding rings, I knew that it was just a matter of time, an evil rain will begin to beat the Nigerian church ...
No generation rises in God beyond the capacity of their intercession... But when I attend conferences and go to bookshop, the subject of intercession are no more available, I knew, that without realizing it, we have removed our defense systems...
Many big and popular preachers among us publicly ridilcled and mocked intercessors because they didn't have fame and didn't have name...
Out of shame, many of those intercessors began to change their brands and their methods of operation, so that, they too will be respected in the land...
But that is why we are where we are today...
We must begin to apologize to all the intercessors we mocked because they didn't have private jets, crowd and massive online followers...
I will say it again, that it will not be long, the Nigerian church will know who there true prophets are ...
For now, we are still following those we love and not those we NEED ... And that is quick way to know a people that have no sense of future...
The consequences are too many ... And unfortunately, this might just be the beginning until we begin again to return to the fortress of intercession...
Only one James was killed and the entire early church halted and amended all their agendas and adopted one war cry:
"Lord, behold their threatenings..."
Esther would gather guys who are present in Shushan and build a wall of intercession with them that became the undoing of Hamman ..... 
Nigerian church is gradually getting to a time when it will become, not just not advisable to gather Christians in a place, but it will become impossible to gather in a place, for fear of bloody attacks ...
With this as our reality today, it is only the vain spirit of Cain that will motivate a people doomed to be exterminated to still be taking risks gathering in a place only to start asking for miracle cars and miracle jobs, the same things the Gentiles are crying for...
I may not be talking to you... But incase it looks like something is shifting in your heart right now as you are reading this...Then, its time for war ...
Gather your people or join a people ...
Raise an altar of intercession in your locality... And let the war cry remain: "Oh that thou wouldest rent the heavens, oh that thou wouldest come down..." 
Let posters and handbills of intercessory prayers start rolling out, gathering believers everywhere...
How many more of our James need to be beheaded, burnt alive inside their churches or houses, our pregnant women ripped open with spear and their children roasted to death even with their toys in their hands?
Oh Nigerian church, I ask: how many more James need to lose their heads?
 It is time to go back to the art of intercession, that rock from whence you were hewned...
It is time to start teaching your people how to wake up in the midnight... 
Not just to pray to kill their enemies but mobilizing angels to pass through the land, to frustrate the token of liars and to make every diviner against God's people mad ...
I don't know for how long but He told us to
"Give Him no rest until He makes the church in Nigeria a praise on the earth..."
Let us pray!
By Iyke Oriaku

title: The car summersaulted three times and the Lord delivered me out unscratched.
text:
The car summersaulted three times and the Lord delivered me out unscratched. 
This was the second time I glaringly experienced raw angelic intervention. And this is how it happened.  
Then I was using a Toyota corolla and I was driving to Ile-Ife. I had prayed with my wife and bid her off because it was always a about week trip.
It happened i had to first visit University Teaching Hospital in Ibadan for a business meeting. As I was driving out,I met an old woman by the exit gate. I looked at her standing helplessly and tired of waiting. I had to slow down my driving and stopped the car by her side. 
I asked where she was going to? She said along Ibadan- Ife road. I didn't know her from any where but I told her to enter the car. 
Upon entering, she told me she retired as a teacher from the destination I was travelling to. But she is not going there . She alighted along the express. 
But before she alighted, she thanked me so much for taking notice to help her. That she was exhausted and lacked transport fare. She said stood at the spot I met to pick her for about 2 hours.  And many people have driven cars out without stopping to help her.
She then prayed for me and specifically told me never to overspeed with the car but drive carefully.  That nothing will happen. 
She alighted and I continued driving just as she instructed.  Without any hole on the road,or any bump,without over-speeding. The car simply lifted itself on the express road and summersaulted three times. 
At that split of seconds, I felt it was a film. It was close to Asejire dam. And people around the vicinity thought the driver would have gone to heaven.
Another surprise was that at the time of the incidence, no car,bus or lorry was coming,the road became vacant 
. Else it would have been a bit clashing with other cars.My car tumbled upside down with the tyres up and roof down. 
By the time i came out from the window side,the car screens had been broken and damaged .The people who came to rescue were still looking for the driver. They couldn't believe it's me. I came out unscratched and the people started to shout and asked how possible. They recounted on the same spot nobody has escaped being crushed before. They started asking if I had any juju or what? Until they see my bible, they started shouting praise God.
They helped turned the car back to its feet. Fixed the tyres back and started the car again. The car started immediately. They drove the car back to Ibadan before us while I was inside another car following them.
When i entered the house without the car,my wife asked why wasn't I travelling again and where was the car? I simply told her it developed faults. It was on the second day I told her what actually happened. My twins were not up to a year then, so they wouldn't have physically know their father if not for that divine rescue. 
Till now,I keep praising God for the divine rescue. And I pray that God will help me fulfil His purpose in Jesus name. 
Lessons 
1. I believe that old woman I helped at the exit gate is an angel in human form. Angels don't appear in a form you will suspect. Angels do posses people too,it's not only demons that possess people. You must understand how to keep doing good,because you don't know you may be helping your helper.
2. No evil can overcome any man who is under God's coverage. 
3. A simple prayer from people who are possessed by angels from God, Spirit of God and anointing. Especially after you have done good to them goes a long way into activating safety, healing, success and glory around your life. You may not see it,but it's happening. 
4. A lot of people are perishing because they couldn't recognise angels around them. 
5. Those God sent to help you are people you may be thinking are in need of your help. If you're not careful you will think they are burdens to you without suspecting your help is far smaller to what they will do for you later.
As a missionary, God once told me to keep hiding from people so they won't suspect a word from my mouth is a game changer. That I should rather behave as if nothing is happening. Even when He sent people around to support the work. Then I understood, there are actually people God places among people without people suspecting them.
Today makes it 833 days,and 698 days we have been praying and interceeding for brethren, missionaries, people and nations every night in two different groups.(all voluntarily and never for any reward)And God is also looking for you to join us as we don't have any date to stop. It's not for the faint hearted. God is interested in possessing you at such level too. May you yield. Inbox to join.
May you and I keep experiencing angelic help from God in Jesus name. 
That was how God prevailed over evil plan against me. May God keep prevailing over my life,my wife and children in Jesus name. Amen. 
You too will always have testimonies of God's help in Jesus name. 
Your brother 
Latunde Akin

title: Days gone past when I was younger and will bed-wet and began to cover it up.
text:
Days gone past when I was younger and will bed-wet and began to cover it up. 
This one was a coded bedwetting o,not a consistent one. 
I remembered I was very smart at hiding bedwetting until one day I was caught. That was my first year in higher institution. Oh ,I felt so shameful and bad. Thank God for brethren 
.
.A turning point came when I had to understand it is not any spiritual attack. It is called nocturnal enuresis (involuntary urination during sleep). It's caused by hormonal imbalances, deep sleep or medical conditions. 
My case wasn't a primary enuresis where it happened everyday,but may be 3 or 4 times a year. But it naturally stopped when I became more conscious of how not to sleep too much again. It faded biologically. 
So when I noticed that in one of my children, I simply understand how to always control her sleeping style by waking to attend to it. I didn't allow that to make her feel so bad to lose her self esteem. I lost mine ,so I wouldn't allow that again in my house. By the time it stopped, the confidence in my children didn't go down.  
And I discovered that most times, we feel so down most of the time because of the kind of people that surrounded us.  If people close to us didn't build our confidence rather than mentally  disciplining us for an involuntary offense. We may grow to become either aggressive or so moody.
When I looked about at some of people, I will smile and simply trace their behaviour back to their background. How people made them feel while they were younger forms the way they behave now unless Christ has totally broken them. 
Now when I remembered people who once made me feel bad because of the limited mindset. I will laugh and tell myself that it's a different ball game now. Battles of life has made everyone of us to calm. And nothing should be able to move anyone of us now unless such hasn't been touched by life's battle.  Now we have been built to some extent to face life squarely and to understand the race isn't to the swift. Never to be worried by anything again but face things squarely and win with God.
To people who still make people feel inferior.
To people who still make people feel bad.

text:

My mother suffered miscarriages for 6 years,had still births and 9 issues wasted before I was successfully given birth to as the first child. 
I grew up being taken cared of,infact my parents had to do other jobs apart from teaching so they could care for me and my younger ones. They tried their best as parent and I give that to them.

I remembered trying to secretly mend ways with people they have hurt without them being aware of it. A wise son doesn't follow his parents foolishly. 
I remembered trying not to mismanage people like they did. It tried to show up but God is helping me never to repeat their mistakes.

Yes,a lot of us stumbled through battles of life and learned it through hard experiences. Of which if we had been informed properly by our parents, we wouldn't have passed through that time wasting route. We wouldn't have goofed at one point or the other in ignorance.
