Many people are only religious and they think religion is knowledge. Not knowing religion is just a practice and not knowledge.

You will learn when to misbehave and when not to.
You will understand that people's smile at you doesn't always mean they accept you. You will not fall into certain sins or certain controllable mistakes. You will truly be free when you know truth about things. You will also understand that hardwork is the stressful aspect you must do to enter into the smartwork arena of life. 
Now,the reason Jesus Christ came is to actually expose us to another level of freedom that spiritual intelligence in God offers.But a lot of believers are limiting themselves to just religion and religion. They will continue to suffer and perish little by little because they lack knowledge. 
"My people perish because of lack of knowledge "
  isn't talking about letters,logos but the rhema of life. Spiritual understanding of what God is actually communicating per time. When you know this,your life won't run into any ditch again! You won't perish despite the fact that you are one of God's people. 
To everyone who has run into a ditch and you looked back and nobody, not even your parents has the spiritual understanding to help you out with. I will encourage you to soak yourself in deep prayers so that such spiritual understanding could be opened up to you through the letters of God's word when you read it.

Do good to bad people. This is how to win in life.

title: The first three cars I used were official.
text:
The first three cars I used were official. 
Mazda 626, Nissan primera,Toyota corolla. All were manual drive.
So when God bought my first car for me,Ford Scorpio,it was still manual. 
Then one day I was driving to Ikire town from Ibadan. On getting to Ikire,I saw one of my long time pastor pushing his car to start. At that time ,I had seen him last 15 years back. I could remember he once accommodated me and took care of me.
The meeting was miraculously unexpected because I was never aware he had been transferred to that town.  I only went to the town to do my pharmaceutical business.
I alighted from my car to go greet him where he was pushing his car. He was surprised to see me. We discussed and went on our ways.
After few days, I told my wife about that Pastor's situation and we prayed for him.
Next I told my wife that,I wished to give my first car to that pastor. After personal consideration, I placed the car for sale and took all the money to the pastor to buy another car of his choice. I didn't tell him that was what I dis until 10 years afte when we met again. He wasn't aware I sold my car and removed nothing from the money to give him.
I didn't want to give him the car directly so he won't know anything or think I did it out of pity. Giving him the cash won't make him suspect its a sacrifice. 
By the way ,my goal was to make only God see me and not even him or anybody. 
I didn't hear anything from God to do that.  It was purely from my desire to sacrifice that for someone who once took care of me as I trusted in God for the best.
Little did I knew after 10 years I would be able to share testimonies of God's goodness to him. At the time I was sharing the testimonies with him 4 years ago. He came to greet me inside a jeep. And I told him that was the 4th replacement after the sacrifice. He was suprised to know it was my first car I sold to give him the money so he could get a better car. He prayed with me and we praised God together. 
Learn this lessons.
It's not everything God must tell you to do before you do it. Sometimes sacrifices are born out of our inner compassion for others as long as it is not a danger to us.
Giving of any kind is strictly spiritual. It is like releasing your virtues into another soil so God can make it multiply in blessing to you. Not a physical blessing, but a spiritual authority to prosper spiritually. Especially when you do to a highly potent spiritual soul. Their spirit prays a lot for you without them knowing it.
Always be a grateful soul. Never forget people in the past that has done you good. Always appreciate them no matter how.
If you really want to move forward in life,you must be a person that thinks impact and impact.  Begging people for things shouldn't be your goal. Putting pressure on people to give you  shouldn't be your skill . You will lose a lot on the long run. It is better to begin to make reasonable impact on those close to you no matter how little. I have list of people that I intercede for without them knowing it since the past 850 days. There are other missionaries God is taking care of through our ministry. You just must be very impactful. 
Give yourself to God and humanity, and there is a way the universe will respond back to you positively.  
Selfishness is when you beg people instead of developing values. 
Selfishness is when you think about yourself alone without having consideration for others that matter. 
God's desire is to make everyone a channel of blessing and not just a receiver but a giver.
In what little way is your life making good impact on others?
Remember, without sacrifice there can't be a success.  And successful people knew this.
Much more,you don't see every reasonable person sacrificing around unreasonable altars. It is a waste of time and resources. 
May you learn from these. Amen 
Your brother

 In God.

People who will look so religious but very silently evil in their imagination. 
People who look so friendly but are only pretending.

title: You suffer because you refused to dare your challenges in the face enough.
text:
You suffer because you refused to dare your challenges in the face enough. 
Many like their comfort zone when they're supposed to move out of such limiting zone in a fanatical way.
After I was told to return the official car of the job that lost me. I knew it was sudden and unexpected, so I tried to apply for a new job at SUMAL biscuits company. The pay was very low to what I earned on the job that lost me,but I felt in my spirit the need to accept that job so I can learn something and also check out immediately with inspiration. 
On getting the job,I worked 12 hours at a stretch checking quality of processes and products.  I became so tired and said to myself, this is a great bondage to me. Much more my salary before was 4 times better than what they wanted to pay me. How can I survive with paying for a four bedroom flat rent in an estate with just 800naira  per day? 
With the inspiration I got about how the company mixed her flour, connected to what I learned from my mother as a chincin baker. I simply didn't return to that job the second day. I can't waste my strength for the second day. 
My wife looked at me and asked why so sudden? I responded it is better to run a chinchin business by myself instead to wasting my strength on a job that can't pay for my accommodation and bills.
No self pity,no looking at anybody's help or hand. I was more  brutal then,so to start afresh wasn't a problem. 
You will be surprised I mixed the flour for chinchin by myself, I will fry them,packaged them and go about hawking them.  It looked like shame because people knew me with a good job and official car. Them seeing me trekking to supply chinchin was actually demeaning. 
I made more money than working in that biscuit company. I made 3 times of what they wanted to give as salary. 
My goal was first, that my wife will never suffer or has any reason to lack. That my children won't grow to have any reason to be needy. I have calculated it that Satan wanted to limit my sphere of good life by that nonsense job,so I quickly broke free! And I was truly free. Infact my friends then looked at me with wonder 
. The rugged spirit was high and because of that God helped me.
Not long after, a restaurant I have submitted proposal to in Lagos four years past remembered to check their files and called me for a consulting job. Boomed within a week I smiled home with big cash. Immediately I stopped chinchin production into another business. 
.
You're suffering because you allowed yourself to be limited. Stop pitying yourself today, use your brain and calculate that you need to immediately go all out for what you know best to do. Stop looking at money, go all out.
It's better to suffer for a good course than enjoying peanut in destiny. 
My wife knows me,that I am a man who can't accept less. I might just be humble, but not wicked ignorant humility. I hustle to the core and I won't accept any job that can box me into penury. 
Get this fact,if you're not spiritual enough not to be boxed,they will box you. So your best bet is to first find God at all cost through divine knowledge and prayer. 
Yes,I know it was a spiritual battle,reason I also decided the rugged wisdom approach,after many night of prayers. You don't find me sleeping anyhow. Many great people don't use all night to sleep but to do something meaningful. So it helps me now as a missionary for God. Never take your night carelessly, that is when real men are made.
Get up! Get out to work that new vision!! God will help you in Jesus name. You will prosper!
Your brother,

title: I once lived in a rented house where all things looked safe.
text:
I once lived in a rented house where all things looked safe. 
But under the surface,there was a very subtle spiritual battle. 
How did I get the accommodation?
I relocated from Lagos to Ibadan about two decades ago and had to put up with a friend for a while as I was on the look out for my personal accommodation. 
My fiancee travelled to visit me from Lagos so we can go together to Oyo town to greet her elder sister. On our way back, I suddenly told her she should let us drive into an estate to check by ourselves whether we can get a flat to rent. Since we have been fasting and praying together since 40 days. My faith was high at the time.
God did us good, as we drove into the Estate extension, I saw this inscription written on the wall 
 "Jesus is Lord". I was very happy and told my fiancee, this is the house we will rent. She marvelled at how I behaved as if I have been to the estate before.  I responded no.
I parked the car,and entered the compound. It was exactly the moment someone was leaving the flat. A NEPA official who was posted to another state. 
So he left, the official living room chairs,two bed in two rooms, and 6 faced gas and electric cooker in the kitchen. The house is a four bedroom flat. 
I was so happy that I don't have to set up the flat immediately. It was a great relief for me. No repairs, no painting  i just paid for the accommodation and entered with only my clothes and the car.
Few months after, I got wedded.  Then the true colour of reality in the house began with me.
.
On my wedding day,I was called to resign my job and returned the official car.
Landlord that was always full of joy at seeing me began to bone face and looked unfriendly. 
Landlord's daughter that would always cry to me to help her get connected to job stopped greeting me.
Children that i used to buy bread for were no where to be found again. 
NEPA officials came and packed all their properties in the flat
Nobody inside the compound even ask about the car when they saw me trekking again. 
I and my wife became shocked at the sudden change of things to us in the house.
Then I started out to look for another and was employed but I only spent just a day. I left because it was a biscuit company and I felt it's better to use that moment to begin my chinchin business,instead of laboriously wasting my time in such company. Much more it was so low compared to my former job.
A friend borrowed me 20 thousand naira, so i went to market to buy half bag of flour,bakingingredients, big frying pot etc. Then we used stove with kerosene. So i started chinchin business with 20,000 naira.
It was like hell was loosen after me. I determined i will work and pay the house rent for the four bedroom flat. Then it was 120,000 naira. 
With 20k business start up, God helped me to gather the accomodation money in 3 months .Then on the day I was to pay the landlord, he collected the money on his sick bed. He died few days after. 
Then i started to pray again to know why he died, God allowed me to know the problem was from his wife. Then I understood the house wasn't that clean. I began 150 days prayer vigil. God bought another two cars for me in the house but it got to a point God said to me that the solution is to leave that house. That was after I had spent another 3 years in the house, but with extra sleepless 1000 days of night prayers. 
God helped me because I could pray,but it got to a point when prayer could no more work than to leave. At that time, we were really stucked again.  About a million naira goods in the store didn't sell for many months. We couldn't eat food again in the house, boomed God told us to leave and go rent another house. 
Immediately we left the house to another house, all the goods got sold out in two weeks! We were amazed and glorified God at the deliverance. 
If you are passing through same ordeal or you got stucked in any situation. Simply understand how to change positions. Changing positions may mean changing locations or your behavioural patterns. Wisdom is key to any breakthrough than prayer. Unless God wants to train you in the school of prayer. 
That you see religious people or houses where they write what they believe for people to see doesn't mean peace. 
You just have to also know that God can lead you to any location so you can fight some battles there so God can use you to prove His power. And when the time to prove Himself is over,you must not remain in that environment but move !
May you and I become wiser. 
God bless you 
Your brother ,
Latunde Akin .

title: TO THE LUKEWARM CHURCH
text:
TO THE LUKEWARM CHURCH
- By Latunde Akin
You are parched, yet you fancy yourself flourishing.
Your vast knowledge has inflated your ego, leaving you oblivious to the precipice of darkness upon which you teeter.
You offer prayers ceaselessly, yet they are as tepid as ice water. Your lukewarm prayers fail to enrich your spirit towards God. Despite everything, you delude yourself into believing you are truly praying.
Your blindness is profound, yet you claim to see.
You revel in the nostalgia of past revivals, yet the fire on your altar has long extinguished, leaving only scattered ashes.
You preach doctrine, not life.
You have permitted Satan to occupy your altars with impunity. Jezebels masquerade as daughters of Zion, and you remain oblivious, deaf and mute to this deception.
You don a suit, concealing truths beneath its fabric. Your pretense is unparalleled.
Outwardly organized, yet inwardly decaying.
You take solace in commemorating death, believing it will lead more souls to Jesus—a falsehood from the depths of hell.
Rather than venture out to bring sinners to the church or take the message of salvation to the streets, you boast in your doctrine.
You weep incessantly, believing tears are what God desires. Genuine godly sorrow has vanished, replaced by feigned tears. God seeks not your weeping but your justice, mercy, and faith—how you treat those around you.
You preach the word, yet it lacks the power to heal even a simple headache, let alone save a life. That God honors His word does not imply He is pleased with the vessel. A tainted vessel will eventually contaminate others.
In times past, when the choir ministered, God's presence was palpable among the congregation. The choir's song would barely conclude before the congregation erupted in prayer.
In days of yore, when spirit-filled men preached, the fire of the Holy Spirit moved mightily upon every soul under their ministry. But now, it is but lukewarm water.
Gone are the days when preachers would spend twelve hours in prayer for a forty-minute sermon. Now they indulge in excess, and when they believe they have delivered a solid sermon, God shakes His head in regret.
Now, they ascend the pulpit for damage control when mysterious deaths occur, using Scripture to justify further deaths. Nonsense. Preaching without fire, without solace. Insensitive sermons, telling the bereaved that 200,000 souls depart this world daily.
Teaching the doctrine of predestination incorrectly. Teaching in a manner demons delight in, allowing them to exploit the ignorance of believers under such ministry.
Yet, your adherence to the doctrine of God's word is commendable. The covenant of God remains vibrant in your midst, while you remain spiritually dead without awareness.
Unless your prayer altar burns with fervor, your self-righteousness and acute lukewarmness will continue to nourish the devils among you. You pray, but your prayers lack the intensity to unveil wickedness and ignite genuine revival.
Return to rebuilding your altar, and let your prayers burn with fervor. Your preaching of truth becomes a relic without the fiery energy of prayer. Satan will perpetuate evil among you, and you will mistakenly attribute it to God's doing.
Resist the devil!
Shatter the chains of ignorance. Dismantle the throne of Jezebel in your midst.
Let the fire become unbearable for them.
Then your God will once again rejoice over you.
He did not save you to become lukewarm or defensive. He saved you to wage war against darkness through prayer. You must be fervent!
Arise, O lukewarm church!
Lest your God spew you out!
Lord Jesus, please revive us genuinely once more.
Amen.

title: HOW TO SPOT A DIABOLICAL PASTOR.
text:
HOW TO SPOT A DIABOLICAL PASTOR.
(By Latunde Akin)
It is alarming the rate at which even many pastors patronize secretly demon worshipers for power,fame and wealth.
Yes,I am a missionary too,but recently I have become so careful of myself as well. How I relate and live my life.
You can imagine a supposed pastor getting caught with juju? Not even pastor from churches where they do mystical preparations in disguise that it is herbal mixture.or prayer mixture.
You see,I am even talking of pastors from Pentecostal holiness,who appear so holy outwardly, and speak in tongues violently. You will be surprised many have gone astray secretly but are only using sound doctrine to cover up.
Recently I discovered people in holiness penticostal churches,I mean workers and ministers who patronizes traditional priests and still come to sing and preach on pulpit. What about many who we expected are believers in Christ who still patronizes celestial or white garment mystical practices. Pathetic!
How do we get here for Christ sake? Is there no balm in Gilead again?
Yes,we will all face trials. Even those traditional or diabolical people they run to also face their own trials. But,if we had experienced the truth and know that God is real,why can't we genuinely wait on Him? Oh,we are in hurry to have good things of life? So we have to deny the efficacy of God's power by circumventing process for quick solutions.
1. When you begin to get tired within you about a particular person who calls himself pastor. It is a sign for two things. Either God is telling you to be careful or Satan is throwing the arrow of tiredness so you won't get blessed again. At this point,pause and logically analyze the person's attitude, you will know something to do quickly through the analysis.
2. The word of God,is the basis for everything a genuine man of God does. If he tells you to read the scriptures yourself on something, and not that he wants to do it for you. Be good. Nobody should read anything at your back. Jesus died and Temple curtain was split opened. We all have access to Him and anyone trying to cover this must be suspected.
3. You noticed that the pastor is clearly and secretly committing sins. That is an indication that he is servicing a demonic altar. Get me right,a genuine man can fall,but he won't continue to fall every time. I have had situations where I fell,oh a blatant falling sef, and humbly I rose from it and went back to Calvary. Not doing God's work at the expense of my soul. 
4. When you begin to notice a pastor is begining to own you. Loyalty aside,you can be loyal to someone who doesn't have entitlement mentality. But if he's beginning to have entitlement mentality,I advise you to watchout for diabolical traits.
5. Brainwashing could be diabolical and it might not. When you are being taught the scriptures verbatim with enforcement like a robot. It means the HOLY Spirit is not around. When they are beginning to psychologically enforce knowledge,demons are around the corner. 
6. Manipulations to donate money is a diabolical sign in such environment. When prosperity teachings dominate more than the teachings on Christian experiences. It is a sign you are in a diabolical system.
7. This is for those who have spiritual eyes. Because many things you won't even see outwardly wrong. But God will open your eyes to see it so that you can be extra careful not to talk anyhow or live carelessly. Not to ever castigate them,but to intercede profusely so God may purge the system.
Be a genuine believer please. You may not be perfect. Yes I am not perfect as well,but I strive to become like my Lord as I look at Him day after day. I have had situations where I happened to be tempted as well,but Christ comes to help my decision. Oh it has even happened that I found myself in a situation I never bargained and my sincererity saw me through. Oh how sweet is it, when our heart isn't harden against brokenness. When we can cry unto God for a total restoration and turn around for good. When we can approach Calvary afresh and obtain mercy at the throne of grace.
If you have been hooked, today the Lord is setting you free in Jesus name. Amen.
God bless us.

title: The car summersaulted three times and the Lord delivered me out unscratched.
text:
The car summersaulted three times and the Lord delivered me out unscratched. 
This was the second time I glaringly experienced raw angelic intervention. And this is how it happened.  
Then I was using a Toyota corolla and I was driving to Ile-Ife. I had prayed with my wife and bid her off because it was always a about week trip.
It happened i had to first visit University Teaching Hospital in Ibadan for a business meeting. As I was driving out,I met an old woman by the exit gate. I looked at her standing helplessly and tired of waiting. I had to slow down my driving and stopped the car by her side. 
I asked where she was going to? She said along Ibadan- Ife road. I didn't know her from any where but I told her to enter the car. 
Upon entering, she told me she retired as a teacher from the destination I was travelling to. But she is not going there . She alighted along the express. 
But before she alighted, she thanked me so much for taking notice to help her. That she was exhausted and lacked transport fare. She said stood at the spot I met to pick her for about 2 hours.  And many people have driven cars out without stopping to help her.
She then prayed for me and specifically told me never to overspeed with the car but drive carefully.  That nothing will happen. 
She alighted and I continued driving just as she instructed.  Without any hole on the road,or any bump,without over-speeding. The car simply lifted itself on the express road and summersaulted three times. 
At that split of seconds, I felt it was a film. It was close to Asejire dam. And people around the vicinity thought the driver would have gone to heaven.
Another surprise was that at the time of the incidence, no car,bus or lorry was coming,the road became vacant 
. Else it would have been a bit clashing with other cars.My car tumbled upside down with the tyres up and roof down. 
By the time i came out from the window side,the car screens had been broken and damaged .The people who came to rescue were still looking for the driver. They couldn't believe it's me. I came out unscratched and the people started to shout and asked how possible. They recounted on the same spot nobody has escaped being crushed before. They started asking if I had any juju or what? Until they see my bible, they started shouting praise God.
They helped turned the car back to its feet. Fixed the tyres back and started the car again. The car started immediately. They drove the car back to Ibadan before us while I was inside another car following them.
When i entered the house without the car,my wife asked why wasn't I travelling again and where was the car? I simply told her it developed faults. It was on the second day I told her what actually happened. My twins were not up to a year then, so they wouldn't have physically know their father if not for that divine rescue. 
Till now,I keep praising God for the divine rescue. And I pray that God will help me fulfil His purpose in Jesus name. 
Lessons 
1. I believe that old woman I helped at the exit gate is an angel in human form. Angels don't appear in a form you will suspect. Angels do posses people too,it's not only demons that possess people. You must understand how to keep doing good,because you don't know you may be helping your helper.
2. No evil can overcome any man who is under God's coverage. 
3. A simple prayer from people who are possessed by angels from God, Spirit of God and anointing. Especially after you have done good to them goes a long way into activating safety, healing, success and glory around your life. You may not see it,but it's happening. 
4. A lot of people are perishing because they couldn't recognise angels around them. 
5. Those God sent to help you are people you may be thinking are in need of your help. If you're not careful you will think they are burdens to you without suspecting your help is far smaller to what they will do for you later.
As a missionary, God once told me to keep hiding from people so they won't suspect a word from my mouth is a game changer. That I should rather behave as if nothing is happening. Even when He sent people around to support the work. Then I understood, there are actually people God places among people without people suspecting them.
Today makes it 833 days,and 698 days we have been praying and interceeding for brethren, missionaries, people and nations every night in two different groups.(all voluntarily and never for any reward)And God is also looking for you to join us as we don't have any date to stop. It's not for the faint hearted. God is interested in possessing you at such level too. May you yield. Inbox to join.
May you and I keep experiencing angelic help from God in Jesus name. 
That was how God prevailed over evil plan against me. May God keep prevailing over my life,my wife and children in Jesus name. Amen. 
You too will always have testimonies of God's help in Jesus name. 
Your brother 
Latunde Akin

title: You must get to a stage in life that what matters most to you is simply to fulfill your original assignment.
text:
You must get to a stage in life that what matters most to you is simply to fulfill your original assignment. 
You're a serious failure if all you love is to have is money. 
You're a serious disappointment to God if all you think to do in life is to keep enjoying what God hasn't designed for your destiny. 
You're a joker if you only live life without a particular vision or dream. 
Yes you can be an employee and still serve purpose.  But you can't be an employee for life. That's why employers retire people at certain age.
Yes,you can still be an employer or entrepreneur who is only merigorounding like a vagabond.  Doing things the wrong way or doing the wrong thing. 
For how long are you going to keep wandering when you already know what you should do?
Problem with many is that they are only interested in the money making aspects of what they do. They are not interested in any solution it brings to their immediate society. They don't think about the benefits it brings to God. 
So whenever you see them giving excuses for not starting anyhow, you already know it's a selfish ambition.  
I remembered starting a CONSULTING company without any dime than the letter head proposals and my leg. I distributed about 100 proposals in just 3 days to various companies in Lagos. Most with leg. I became so zealous all because I wanted to achieve something valuable.  At the end of 3 months, it yielded results in hundreds of thousand. That was in 2004 and you can imagine how much it worth then. I worked business with U.I,UNILAG etc. 
You shouldn't believe anything can stop you if you're truly ready.  Not even lack of money must be allowed to demoralise you. 
Get up! Money will meet you on the way! Not while you're sitted! Money doesn't answer people who are redundant. Money is a virtue not a paper. Virtues must go out of you to attract another virtue of like passion. 
That's why givers never lack. Especially when they attract virtue from God by giving to missionaries and mission works. There's is always a release from God spiritually. It works too through hardwork ,just that God must be involved. 
Yes you may suffer at first, but believe it ,it's just for a while. You will have breakthroughs. 
Hear me and hear me well! Stop wasting your life doing nonsense. Enter straight into your destiny if you already know it.
You will prosper.  In Jesus name.  Amen 
Your brother

For me I think, there are stages of discovery in life. And much more ,battles of life can change people 
. I became tough, more friendly, more expressive and more complicated and simple at the same time.

As a believer in Christ, never try to allow your temperament rule you. You must remain simple to people but complicated to devils.

Do not allow what people call you to determine how you live,but what God calls you.

Your brother,

This is because they can't see what you're seeing. 
They are not facing the reality of your reality, so they may want to conclude you're lazy,foolish or have mental imbalances. 
I remembered when a job lost me. Many who were close will offer their candid advise on what I should do. I will respond to them that's not the solution. The solution is to seek the Lord until what is wrong get corrected spiritually. 
You know you have a spiritual problem and you think to employ physical means to solve it! You're joking! You are a joker sef.
20 years ago I voluntarily resigned from Tasty Fried Chicken as Quality Control Executive. Little did I knew there were battles ahead. I simply became tired of the job and then ventured into Consulting work.  It also crashed and I became totally paplexed and down. 
After careful spiritual observation, I decided to seek God in prayers till He answered. 
During the time of praying, I will resume to prayers in the morning and close at night. If anyone asked what work  I was doing, I will answer its prayer. How do I ate? I got support from friends basically. They knew they can't convince me otherwise not to pray because they already know their support doesn't move me. If they refuse to support, I was never ready to be influenced by their support. 
I looked into many people's face and dared them because I strongly believe they didn't know a pinch of what I was passing through spiritually.  They thought it was simply a job loss,but I knew it wasn't just ordinary loss. So i stayed put in my prayer bushes for two years praying until the God opened another source. 
Do not think to allow people dictate solutions that is not from God to you. No matter how supportive they are, if their support is aiming to stop you from praying or misdirect you away from the depth of seeking God . Please look into their faces and tell them to go to hell with their support.

title: FREE SCHOOLS OPERATION IN THE COUNTRY.
text:
FREE SCHOOLS OPERATION IN THE COUNTRY.
By Latunde Akin.
King Abolarin of orangun Ile-Ila started free schools many years ago till date in his town. He isn't collecting any dime from the students. How he is paying the teachers possibly from his other personal business.
Brother Gbile Akanni, refused to be called Pastor, Reverend, Apostle, Evangelist,but he is very much effective than to be called those titles. He started free schools without collecting any dime from the students. Only whatever any parents or anyone can donate freely to support,never compulsory or mandatory. The free schools still runs their administration basically from free (not forced) donations and other sources. They don't depend on school fees from any student.
Federal government operates some free unity schools,yes we know they use people's tax to do that freely. At least to show free school is possible.
There are other individuals around who also operates free schools which I may not list here. 
To tell you,operating free school is highly possible in this society by good spirited people who are privileged to operate it.
To tell you,the present church should be the living example to champion free schools across and sundry. But we are clearly not leading in this free school aspect.
To tell you, the early missionaries championed free schools,but the glory of all of that is no more. This is what affected the church in USA,UK too. They lost their love for humanity to love for money and building of big projects. Those big cathedrals are empty now due to misplaced priorities. 
Ministries who use education to do pure business now hide under giving scholarships to selected people. 
Let's say they collected 1M from 1000 students,that is 1 billion they then use 100M to offer 100 students scholarship. They are left with a whooping sum of 900M. After paying salaries and removing other administrative costs,at least 200M or more will remain as profit. See pure business? The church people that donated their widow's mite may never have a taste of that scholarship or that school.
Do we say if all churches school are free,they will still have capacity to admit everyone? Big NO.
Do we say if they don't collect school fees they will survive? Big YES.
They will survive from the same donations from their members which built the school in the first place. Unless the money used to build the school is from individual purse and not from church members donation. Then the school shouldn't be named after church organization or ever be connected to the church. Businesses should stand separate from the gospel.
It is disgusting and disheartening to hear that REVIVAL means church taking over industrial facilities. 
It is disgusting to hear that REVIVAL means church taking over the educational sector. And because church schools are doing better than government owned schools,it means REVIVAL. That is ridiculous.
Revival isn't when we make money. Revival isn't when we are more organized. Revival isn't when we increase in endless numbers. Revival isn't even miracles.
Revival is when FAITH, MERCY AND JUSTICE is being uphold by the church. Revival is when the fire of love is burning and people are getting lit up by the love like wildfire. 
It is sad that the prosperity gospel has unconsciously crept into the faith based , holiness based,prayer based and Bible based churches as well. Everyone of them now wants to prosper in money and so must do side businesses.
Are side businesses wrong for the church? No they are not. But that's not what Christ desires for his church. The focus of Christ isn't any business. And if we're not careful,this may cause downward trend for the gospel message.
It would have been preferable that the church set up a free school system and decide to run the administration and staff payment from donations by members or well wishers.
It would have been preferable to God that the church rather support individual members and encourage them to start businesses and schools by empowering them. 
It would have been preferable to God that the church build businesses away from the confinement of the church and refrain from using church name to do business.
A mission based school that is not free is a pure business.
May God please reset the brain of the church. Amen.

title: WHEN YOUR PRIVATE PART SMELLS.
text:
WHEN YOUR PRIVATE PART SMELLS.
- By Mfon Ekott
Permit me to invade your privacy today, this once. 
Well, I just want to point out something you never knew, or probably have been ignoring; about your "inner chambers", that place you always dread talking about, because you believe it's personal. 
How healthy are you in there? Are you proud of it? 
Oh, no! Not about your genitalia, far from it. I'm referring to those areas of your life that are oblivious to the public, your "behind the scenes", that is your private part. 
Is it as healthy as that part you flaunt in public? 
WHO REALLY ARE YOU? 
 A godly satan.
 Angelic demon. 
 Beautiful beast. 
 Glorious wreck.
 Holy sinner.
 An online influencer, but an offline influenza. 
 A minister on the podium, but a sinister in the house. 
 A public angel, but a private beast. 
 A healer in the open, but a virus on the inside. 
 A humble lady at work, but a whirlwind at home. 
 A gentleman in public, but a terror in your home. 
 A noble in-law, but son of destruction to family. 
 A spirit-led brother in church but an abusive manipulator with your wife. 
 You worship your Daddy/Mummy GO, but have no regard for your parents/spouse.
 You don't get tired of commending girls for their beauty, but your woman gets no compliment after dressing.
 You get too busy counseling other children that you fail to notice your child's desire for your love and attention. 
 You're benevolent to strangers, but your family and people in your inner space are subjected to penury. 
 You attack people's children for their shortcomings, but yours are impending nemesis, waiting to happen...
Oh, dear! Your private part is faulty, sick, and decaying. 
You smell. You stink. You rot. 
Your stench is awful. 
A thought of you is nauseating. 
It is about time you fixed yourself. Get help and strive to stay healthy. Only you are responsible for your healing, no one else. 
Acknowledge that you're sick in there, identify the causative factors, examine where the stench is oozing from, and make steps towards self healing. 
Remind your charity that it has a home. 
Let the beauty of your soul and your goodness be felt by the people in your inner space first, before strangers. 
Be a father/mother to your own children first, before attempting to become Mother Theresa or Santa Claus. 
Set your house in order!

(By Latunde Akin)
Matthew 23:23
Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
Most destructive to men is when men who are supposed to teach and raise people the right way are not doing so. Jesus pronounced WOE unto them. This is because they are channelling their attention and people's mind to the minors while they neglect the weightier matters. 
Tithing is in the bible, giving is in the bible, and sowing seed is in the bible. But are they weightier matters? 
Church administrators are now targeting people's money at the expense of properly leading them to the Lord and teaching them consecration. 
If you must make God's people rich by teaching them to give money.Then that is both a wrong concept and a minor matter of the scripture. 
The major is to make men disciples of Jesus and not to derail them by pushing them to sow seed so God can bless them.
 It is better to teach dignity of labour and show them how to physically or mentally work with their hands instead of only calling them to donate to be blessed in return. Even this is still secondary to our mandate as believers. Creating such entitlement mentality in people towards God is wrong. A scam it is.
If we say we are of Christ as leaders, we must avoid operating like a capitalist government. A capitalist government milk dries the poor for the rich. In church, the rich must avoid every tendency to make the poor feel so bad or cheated. 
The widow who brought her mite coins was recognised by Jesus not because she was a giver but because Jesus wanted to do justice to her. She didn't have much, yet she gave it all. Then, for justice sake,Jesus sighted her to actually bless her. 
If people who give their all still remain the same in our congregation, then it means we have neglected justice, mercy,and faith. 
We do not say that we should be open to every Tom Dick and Harry. No,but we should be open enough to consider people who are genuinely poor or needing among believers and provide for them from the proceed of offerings given by everyone.
Charity must always begin from home. Not from the outside. If it's from the outside, then it turns to propaganda. 
Discipleship and fellowship should be key and paramount than any church project.
God is not bothered about how many people gathered in a church service. He is bothered about how they are being discipled,treated, and their quality of life. You can have 100,000 members gathering while God only knows a few people. You can have 10 people who are genuinely known by heaven because they will be more useful to God than a congregation of numerous churchy people. 
As much as I am not against tithing and offering. I still mention that they are never weightier matters of the kingdom.  Weightier matters are :
The church's judgment or justice system.The administrators must be just to understand that poor brethren must be recognised like Jesus did to that widow. Every system in the church that relegated the poor or less previledged because of lack is a lost church in God's sight. 
Faith is a belief in God, not for material things but for salvation of hearts in the church. Jesus wasn't talking about faith for material needs. As long as the salvation message is lost in the church, faith in its real sense is lost. Collecting money from people at the expense of silencing salvation messages is evil. 
- Mercy is an act of pardoning people and giving them what they need.  Jesus pardoned us, and he didn't stop there. He gave us salvation. We must also show mercy to other believers in the church. Have provision to help the needy among believers first, before any unbeliever. 
Mercy has criteria, and that is why God said, "unto whom I will..." We must understand that we are not to show mercy to someone who will waste it. 
A lazy man's mercy is to deliver him from laziness by giving work and not money.
A beggar's mercy is to show him how not to beg again and not necessarily aiding his begging capability. 
An entitlement mentality person doesn't deserve any mercy at all. We must teach such people responsibility. 
A believer who is not defaulting but sincerely found himself or herself in such a condition must be shown mercy. 
An unbeliever who is genuinely in need must be shown mercy. This may win such to the Lord. We must be winsome, but we must not allow deception to thrive.
WOE unto every church administrator who collects money from people and neglects JUSTICE, MERCY, AND FAITH. 
It then means the law of giving does not supercede the law of justice, mercy, and faith. 
Jesus proclaimed WOE unto church leaders who esteem the message of giving money than the message or dealings of justice among brethren, mercy on the needy and faith , and the saving faith. 
Of what use to the Lord is a church where there is no genuine love? 
Charity(love) is the reason for fellowship and never capitalism.
Of what use to the Lord is a church where poor believers remain poor just because the system of such such operates a capitalistic system?
It is WOE unto such leaders of such bad church system, for they esteem giving by people more than the weightier matters of the scripture. Their woes may even be waiting for them at the judgment sit of Christ if they won't repent early enough. 
Giving is good, offering is good, but justice, mercy, and faith are better. 
God bless.

title: A grand deception is going on amongst many churches now.
text:
A grand deception is going on amongst many churches now.
Many like to preach what will increase their membership, but what will scatter those members abroad to go and disciple others,they won't want to preach. 
Some like to preach the finished work of Jesus (salvation) and other added juicy benefits. 
But to preach the unfinished work of Jesus, which is MISSIONS. They won't want to preach it so as to keep cycling their membership because of love for fellowship and benefits of fellowship. 
They forget fellowship isn't the ultimate intention of God,but Missions. Reaching the unreached and discipling all tribes of people. 
Do you know most churches now prefer holding crusades in cities where people are already reached with the gospel. What is the motivating factor around this?
May I tell us that many great men have lost focus. Bible study is good, but what use is Bible study that keeps feeding people to stupor? Much knowledge, less practicalities. Many don't even have Bible study anymore. They would rather sing, motivate,dance, and enjoy speaking in tongue. 
This deception must cease amongst us. if we must become fulfilled by taking the gospel personally to others,we must stop building empires.
Another deception is making merchandise using the church all in the name of establishing businesses. Using religion to make ourselves rich at the expense of doing the real work of missions. 
What is the real work of missions? Focusing on people's need for salvation and discipleship more than focusing on big projects building or big crusades that don't reach places that are yet unreached. 
Brethren, if you won't deceive yourself, you will discover that your brain has been wired to always attend services or programs every day but never to scatter to go places and preach the gospel. 
Romans 15:20  says, "  My ambition has always been to preach the Good News where the name of Christ has never been heard, rather than where a church has already been started by someone else."
From the above,can we see how far we have gone at deceiving ourselves? 
And even those who are trying to scatter themselves into those unreached places, we don't financially support them. We complain by saying that organising big programmes and projects are demanding much finances. So we neglected the real deal just because it's not FASHIONABLE!
God will judge a lot of us this neglect if we don't repent. 
Believer in Christ, please I adjure thee to arise personally in support of missions and missionaries. If you can't go,let your virtues,and your blood go! Your money is your blood! It is your virtues and it speaks louder on the field of souls. That is if you can't go because of your career and work. You can determine to pray for the work as well at a schedule time of the day.
If you're not intentional about doing your part,you're simply wasting your life attending fellowship just to please yourself and not God.
HAVE COMPASSION MISSIONS is dedicated to helping Believers in Christ recognise their urgent need to arise and become burdened with the burden of the Lord to reach out and disciple others like themselves. We have missionaries across the nation that we encourage day by day in support. 
 As you are led to support them on mission fields or you are called to prepare to go yourself. Simply get in touch with us on messenger. 
In whichever way,do not let the deception of churchianity gets into your head. The Lord is going to ask you personally about your impact in His kingdom after He had saved you from sin,Satan and sickness. 
In a local government where I know. There are big churches in the town whereas,in the neighbouring settlements of about 169 villages,I was suprised to discover that,there is no gospel around there. The people are starked unbelievers. Yet none of big churches want to go there! 
We should not be decieved. We we reap what we sowed. God is waiting for us to sow in tears of compassion for souls. By this,we are reaping in a great harvest for God. 
Not in deception of FELLOWSHIP in over-ripe places ,but in the penetration of FIELDS that are ripe with genuine gospel outreaches and support. 
God bless everyone who sees sense in this. Amen

title: It is not what you preach that actually and eventually bless people, it is who you are before God.
text:
It is not what you preach that actually and eventually bless people, it is who you are before God. 
You can be preaching a sound doctrine from your head,and people can even enjoy it temporarily or permanently but if in your spirit man you're not what you preach, the name of the Lord is going to be tarnished by you.
A situation where God is using you mightily when you have long derailed is just that God is using you to prepare your replacement without you knowing it.
God knows your lifestyle is doing enough damage already than the truth you spill out every time. And since your secret life is not known to a lot of your followers, He must intentionally at least keep using you to prepare many others who will replace you.
At least before you can tarnish His image or bring disgrace to His service, He would have prepared enough people who will stand against you through you. And if by mercy your heart is not hardened, those people.God is about to replace you with may become Intercessors around you. They may tell God to have mercy on you if you treat them well or if mercy is still speaking around you.
I see a very dangerous trend coming, a situation where many will fall into the trap of knowledge of God without life of God. 
I see armies of the Lord fighting aimlessly thinking they're on track or fighting for God who can fight for Himself without them. 
I see those who are carried away by popularity of preachers and their long years of experience without knowing God is already changing people for His works. 
I see believers getting carried away by what they only know,forgetting God is multidimensional and will always reveal Himself more than what we think we know.
If you're in a denomination, just be careful not to think it's your denomination that knows God better. Else you may be digging your spiritual grave without knowing. 
And what should concern every believer is his or her life before God and not any hero worshipping or hyping. We will all stand before God individually and by then we will understand that the journey is not a corporate journey. 
Yes,battles are not to be fought alone,but God won't ask us about battles but about our personal obedience to Him.
In what area or aspect have you been carried away? It is better to gain back your senses now and begin to personally obey the Lord. If you have to obey Him at the expense of what men of influence around you are saying, its far better. 
That anyone preaches the truth doesn't qualify any preacher as true. You just have to ensure you stand in the Truth by yourself and by the grace given to you.
Never believe anyone verbatim. Only believe in the Word of God,because that is the only way you can be free indeed. 
Today, every shackle of religious activities around you is broken. Every scale in your eye is shattered. Every breathe of human beings around your journey is replaced by the breathe of Life. And you will begin to experience peace of mind, and swift  progress in your journey of faith. In Jesus name, amen.

title: Tithing is not a criterion for salvation and eternal rest.
text:
Tithing is not a criterion for salvation and eternal rest.
Tithing is for our own good and not God's. 
Tithing could be done as strictly led by God. The storehouse is the church, the church is not building but saints. Abraham paid to Melchisedech,a Saint higher in authority to him. Always pay to where divine utterances are issued upon you. Where intercessions are always made on your behalf. 
Tithing is not an old testament thing, it predates old testament. The principle behind it is relationship with God and administrative care of God's people, not only His servants. 
The storehouse in old testament was because then tithe wasn't monetised then,as farm products were supplied and must need to be stored. It doesn't mean an individual like Melchizedec can't recieve it. 
Those who disobey Tithing doesn't have a relationship with God either or that they have decided to give all of themselves to God which is better than it.
There are better laws than the law of Tithing, but a Christian obeys all and neglect none.
If paying Tithe is all about material prosperity or non payment is about punishment from God then those who believed so have missed it. 
God can't punish anyone who disobey paying, because in the first instance He will see them as not in relationship with Him. How can God punish someone that is not even qualified to pay it? I see no business with any who is not born again paying it.
 That God blesses an unbeliever who pays it is what has put the church into many troubles we are having now. We take delight in collecting Tithe from unbelievers at the detriment of God's expectation and we thus lower the efficacy of God's word in our own mouth. 
An unbeliever paying Tithe has simply come to steal from us. He will naturally become blessed but his soul will become lean in return. The system of payment has been bastardised.
Tithing is only meant for believers not unbelievers. 
Tithing is not a business of give and get. It is only those who love God in a relationship that should do it.
If a believer notices the proceed is being mismanaged,God can direct a believer to pay where its going to be well managed. Especially to the work of soul winning and not to frivolous projects and programmes. 
God bless

title: WHY DO CHRISTIANS READ BIBLE UPSIDE DOWN?

WHY DO CHRISTIANS READ BIBLE UPSIDE DOWN?
Happy New year friends.
Just to settle this matter about first fruit and go back to my shell. This year is for more of God and less of other things. 
God strictly mentioned any produce that comes first, not all set or group of all first produce. God asked or demanded sample and never everything.
Fruits ripe in batches, your first salary is never your first fruit, but your first day worth as a sign or symbol of dedication to God and not even as any gift to God.
And since your salary is a combination of a 31 day income, which comes monthly and first on every first month of year. Your first day income is the first fruit, not all monthly income. God is not looking for a faith that you cannot carry from you. He is looking for your honor to Him, and fellowship with Him.
Stop making doctrine out this,and please know that it is now a free will offering in the new testament, not mandatory. 
What is mandatory is the salvation of our soul, as every believer is now a first fruit unto God. James 1:18 - In the exercise of His will He brought us forth by the word of truth, so that we would be a kind of first fruits among His creatures.
Check these old testament verses and see the real meaning of first fruit by yourself.
Exodus 34:26
"You shall bring the VERY FIRST  of the first fruits of your soil into the house of the LORD your God. "You shall not boil a young goat in its mother's milk."
Numbers 18:12-13
"All the best of the fresh oil and all the best of the fresh wine and of the grain, the first fruits of those which they give to the LORD, I give them to you. "The FIRST RIPE fruits of all that is in their land, which they bring to the LORD, shall be yours; everyone of your household who is clean may eat it.
Ezekiel 44:30
"The FIRST of all the first fruits of every kind and every contribution of every kind, from all your contributions, shall be for the priests; you shall also give to the priest the first of your dough to cause a blessing to rest on your house.
Please mark the words in CAPITAL letters and see for yourself the right perspective. Not a whole of the first produce.
Thank you.
Yours
Latunde Akin
